AP: Georgia Supreme Court overturns some election rules, curbing State Election Board’s power [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081325_2&amount=25]
Team: Georgia’s highest court recently overturned four rules passed by the State Election Board just before last year’s general election, ruling the board overstepped its authority and intruded on lawmaking power reserved for legislators under the state constitution.
To refresh your memory: The State Election Board passed a slate of controversial new rules in August and September of 2024, including requirements that ballots be hand-counted after the close of polls, that someone delivering an absentee ballot in person provide a signature and photo ID, that county election board members be allowed to conduct a “ reasonable inquiry ” before certifying results, and that county election board members be granted broad access to election-related documents.
These new rules brought an outcry that the board’s majority was trying to improperly use its power to help MAGA candidates and follow disproved conspiracy theories about our elections.
The state Supreme Court’s unanimous decision to overturn these highly partisan, suppressive rules limits the ability of the State Election Board and other executive branch agencies of Georgia’s government to try and put their fingers on the scales and tip elections their way.
We know this isn't the end of voter suppression in Georgia, Team. Chip in $25 or whatever you can today to provide the resources we need to defend our right to vote in states like Georgia, in the courts, and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081325_2&amount=25]

Do YOU oppose DOGE accessing your personal data?
#

Just yesterday, another U.S. court confirmed that Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency — otherwise known as **DOGE — can legally access the personal data of MILLIONS of Americans like you.** **This includes _sensitive information._** Social Security numbers. Phone numbers. Health records. Employment records. Addresses. We think most Americans would agree on this... **DOGE shouldn’t be anywhere near our private information.** But after this ruling, we want to confirm with you, Peter: **Do YOU oppose DOGE accessing your personal data?** **[YES — I'M OPPOSED](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93681?t=1&akid=9268%2E614464%2EnxmbaS)** **[NO — I SUPPORT IT](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93681?t=2&akid=9268%2E614464%2EnxmbaS)** **[I'M NOT SURE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93681?t=3&akid=9268%2E614464%2EnxmbaS)**

I refuse to stay silent while they try to disenfranchise us, and I hope you’ll join me in fighting back.

Burrows issued civil arrest warrants Aug. 4 for the dozens of House Democrats who left the state to deny quorum, the minimum number of people required for the House to take up legislation. Those warrants can only be enforced within state lines, making them largely symbolic for the lawmakers who had absconded to Illinois, Massachusetts and New York.

But Burrows and Paxton took the unusual step of asking courts in those states to carry out the warrants and bring the lawmakers back to Texas.

Illinois courts' cannot consider whether "foreign legislators" were willfully evading their duties, and they cannot direct Illinois law enforcement to execute civil quorum warrants upon "nonresidents temporarily located in the State of Illinois," Larson said, noting that the warrants specifically say they are to be enforced within Texas. The lawsuit was filed in Illinois' westernmost county, four and a half hours away from the Chicago suburb where the Democrats have camped out. subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2znudnaus3ajprj49nbt4kl4pujojflseo6s7jidg_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhmaor1c5h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5pdc3qdae1k1eu9cnkl3to8422qruec1jlp2jio_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhmaor1c5h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zmp8dudca3qir1esnb54refg2opktcupjhai4pf0_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhmaor1c5h2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zrhtor4g3geadnd43f900ic0ts3mb8a8mncsc638_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhmaor1c5h2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zk0tgaeb0dmh5p12rt4itqr0untpkfom7te7er70_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhmaor1c5h2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

body:
I hope you can take a moment to read, in full, this letter to you. It’s from the heart and important to me. This has been the most draining and emotionally challenging ordeal of my life.

| [****](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1v7v7jspt0u8ujvd6h9b56n1c59g1tlvl0r4t5g_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs)
[****](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zff7nfimhu6d52dbj8khbprtm58keh515b24i83o_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs) Dear Patriot,

I hope you can take a moment to read, in full, this letter to you. **It 's from the heart and important to me. **

This has been the most draining and emotionally challenging ordeal of my life.

**When I started Project Veritas, my intent was pure and remains so**. I wanted to expose the corruption and hypocrisy in our society and governments.

I wanted to give you a glimpse behind the curtain by presenting raw video footage of what goes on behind closed doors.

And I did it, time and time again. **I'll continue to do so until my last breath.**

But the people I trusted at Project Veritas turned on me. They effectively terminated me, and when that wasn't enough, they sued me to stop me from doing the work that fires my heart.

That lawsuit continues today; it's a massive burden, but it's part of my mission to tell the truth, and **I need your help to keep fighting to bring the darkness to light**. [** Will you donate today to my legal defense fund?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn8j0rd288lohgdjhp6hk3eke7ls3o0gbs3salp8_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs)

Our bills continue to grow, and as we near trial, [**I can't do it without your help**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z197m18ottpjjmn131oiqen7fjbtb2i5vu480s98_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs).

But we will win, and you will know the truth and be able to see for yourself who was behind the destruction of the organization I poured my heart and soul into.

[**Your support means I can keep fighting to expose the truth**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjsrn5t8bqc95o28ul4b8nhq5icg6mv9j5l3pq8g_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs) that's locked behind closed doors.

Almost a year ago today, I filed a counterclaim against Project Veritas. That gave me the ability to pursue justice rather than sit on the defense.

The ongoing case is all about that. It's not only about justice, but also about gathering facts through discovery, depositions, and our eventual trial.

While I can't share those facts right now, [**with your help, the truth will come out**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvneccokoft6cmfqqmohqdijj8s9j2ra826urr68_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs).

My parents taught me to see the world in binary colors, black and white, good and bad. Over my years of work, **I've come to realize that the more good that you do, the more the devil will try to stop you.**

From this lawsuit to countless others, from being locked up as a young man on false charges, to having the FBI raid my home in the early morning hours**, the devil has tried to break my spirit, kill my will, and discourage me from doing the good that's a result of my passion.**

And during all of those trials, **people like you have stood by me**. Good people who choose to stand by me and smile in the face of evil and say, "**not today, satan . . . not today**."

[**Your support not only helps me keep going**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjnfmv621eglkjsv9quh8t7r6hno0g9i9trtdrt0_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs), but it gives me hope that **darkness will never overtake the light as long as there are people like us still breathing.**

So thank you. Sincerely, thank you.

[**Please donate today and help me keep this fight going, sending a message that good still exists in this world**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5u30o0afg5jfldkg6vi253rm9ar01hego12uesg_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chhm6pb1c1h2bs).

Thank you for all that you do.

In truth,
James O’Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

Friend,

I don't know how else to say this... But something _historic_ is happening. body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---

---

Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_

You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zagdho5k62d49hv9lp2f5pb99bgrplnv4lshol68_rp22sh2s8i6epb5chjm0p36chh2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. Friend,

**_“So help me God.”_**
---
On May 20, 1981, I raised my right hand and took an oath to defend the Constitution against all enemies, _foreign and domestic._
---
**So when President Trump asked me to serve as his lawyer and fight for his freedom and justice,_I did not hesitate even for a second!_

_And now, I’ve learned the price._

**And after 52 YEARS of faithfully serving the law,_ALL_ of my law licenses have been taken away from me as a way to stop me from defending myself in court.**

---
_President Trump once said that I had “guts” for defending him against the vengeful and bloodthirsty Deep State._
---
Truth be told, that wasn’t about courage – that was me simply honoring my oath.
---
**_But what I’m about to do right now will truly take guts..._**
---
_God knows I hate this, but I’m about to ask for your help._
---
Friend, the situation I find myself in today is simple, but sadly, bleak.
---
My last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like _YOU_.
---
That’s why I’m making a final plea – _a Hail Mary_ – to humbly ask that you contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust.

**_No matter what happens, I’m holding on to the final words of my oath: “ _So help me God_ ”._**

## Trump: Cease-Fire is Goal of Putin Meeting
Trump and Putin will meet Friday at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Alaska, marking [Putin’s first U.S. visit in nearly a decade](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_O2yAUBfCnwduNMGA7DAxd2L6uHS0Cl_j2448FJFH69FX6Cp2P9NM559fX_uUoUbn_dBnNiHUv-OoJx8C259rwqBkbRiqueOwJew-NdsHFAvwKs9qDo_Te1RRMRBQoJzTztizzumgppsMof4tR6dVzjauOi5bXWwgew7ohqs1PZD4av85q5nyR80XdnL75TciVzxq1ZIpjoFHb5XelMg6M6V2f2C6-5imZY4yzM_mDCcuELe-z9vGJmLAfmAnLr0zYWTJhX7WlAJ-JTNjRHvmEZ311yI4K3KtLUCOcj0EFXHL920F_5EwDqIOD89EPiLWBR9cRIjWEP5iw9O83E3ZqJpwvSon6ujHF79lR-ldy_NezTyP-BgAA__8a7I5K) and the first with a U.S. president since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Trump told European leaders and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky that his [top goal is securing a cease-fire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuq3DAURb9G7jTo4ce4cDEhuEi4t0lxSyNLR-MT9DDS8Zj5--D8wm33gg1rfX0sHwYDpueniTCRz0uCswYggrLEXGDLEQp4TCZZqAFqdQUXJVTHxZ3LdnEGw3tpGzd5AAW6gUkOXSf7btSq2SbZrcrepTKg9biKoV9HZ_3ohlYqOVjb4HS9ibtspRCdlrd2NeNqB6V7IUcYNWsFOKRcbn8zJtrAh3d-QbnZHJswbUR7ZfrB1MzUfJ7nLdZ0MaZmSPyoTM2X1AVzCe6aj5J3MIkHMA5K5QSJDOELwptveQd_BG48QeHWhMBPpI1TOeLOzQbG8ez5fhAmXo8YkZiaTeGPh_xdP79-MT1ni47pnz-usHDWP1D2pkxuPzEErP3AWvGMBsN_BfpW99ek_gUAAP__CLeZ7w), with no final deal made without Ukraine’s involvement. Zelensky and allies rejected Putin’s push to recognize Russian control of occupied territories, urging tougher sanctions instead. Trump warned of “[very severe consequences](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO2yAURp8Gb0RwwdgeGCpVljqka0cLm-v4thgiuEmat6_SV_jnT_p0zvl1Xa6BEuXbz3Ci570sGV8tITPW5SwVj3JixZ1yyBu2hK3FSgso6KUapbZLDJTei-2i3xEBTYdeD32vXT8Z6A4fnZlW6HGyaDQA7NMKw7jCOETlNu068p83NWqrleqNvtg1TOs2gHFKTzgZYRVG4lIvvwtlPnBP7_LEetnK2SV_MN-bMN8EzALmsG4fg8utfGYB84_MWHNgKjkkATPXx3mX9wdTliciy0SNMVO-SfyLdaOG8nUQozzKo6H886angLlxqW9hZorCfNdgnQI3Qld9vL8oJWpuEFbdzkDpPxd_KebTw78AAAD__8RiiVE)” if Putin refuses to halt the war, but left those measures undefined.
## Home Refinancing Jumps 23% as Owners Cash Out
Mortgage applications climbed nearly 11% last week, driven by a [23% spike in refinancing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuunDAARVdjOpB_DFC4SEM3aVMig6-xE39GtjVodh_xpLeCVx_p6N7z57k9tQ8-nb91hGo2bwlXDWgNZYu5wOWIAuuTTgdqQK2m-I1TPvZ07pncjPbhs8nOKAtwiA6KTePIHuMieOcUJMw0j8xaBq0p1UwYJoW1O-QkKTqvbhudmWSUjoINctfLfkxcPChbsAgiKYxvuQx_s0_NwYZPfqMMR45dUK61VyXiF-Er4et1XcOR9uOGhK-3mvCVzoSvTNwc-Bc-fcylnfpE__3Np7OvLudWey5eKAdS650_HcrgWgxdUeZ1-RB8fUxE0jNqH74WtB9leyv-PwAA__8q-IGB), especially adjustable-rate loans. With sales lagging while home prices rise, cash-out refinancing hit a three-year high in the spring, [averaging $94,000 in equity](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAQBeDT2B0RM4AdCopt0v3bbmkRGOxZYZMFkii3X3mLvcBfjkZ6et_79bV8ec58rD_9Tq6nshz0bpl6p7rspdJWdqqU-PBHoJaptVh5QYlGyKsAvUTP-bPoMbpEhKRGcjAbA5OxCsfNmWAMxBRUiBLBKqsj2KQAJ5QGbBzZnWnyChqkNAou-u7tPcyoJgmWrBq0pMi91MvvwkffKOVPeVG9hLKP2W29P9qgfgx4G_DmHyfgfJ1H7RwyDXg7GYL-PLl_xH-O2Evtq19JVN-pia08Gx-r8DokJFCQ5rv2cULUEZIhNSmK8zWM1cXHm3PmNs2DluvuOf9r07814cvh3wAAAP__5FCE2A) withdrawn. National housing inventory in July rose nearly 25% from last year, with [Nevada, Maryland, and North Carolina](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O7CAUg5-GdERwgPwUFLdJN7fdMmLCYcKIwAjYRHn7FfsK27mwbH_-eqwP44OPr__mQF1dWiNeJWCtmNcjZdzTgRmdjyZuWAKWYrNfgYGibKJcrtb4cK-ys9ohAooONR-V4oOaBXS7FkY9JydBDjiimJRgAHZwwggzCQem87qlsYlLzpgSvJdPMz-3EcTA-IyzIJKh9TXl_p18rDu6cKcTc7-lowt6r_VTiPhHYCGwXNfVZzSh2bd0EFgaEIGlZoy2iUZUqEuZFhOQ-nhirCnf9P0dbtq2EFi6rO3n8iH4MoxEstdhfPgtrH966dTwEwAA___lF3uu) leading double-digit gains. Homes are taking longer to sell, giving buyers more choices, but affordability remains tight.
## Alcohol Consumption Hits Historic Low
Fewer than 55% of U.S. adults now say they drink alcohol, the [lowest share in Gallup’s 86 years of tracking](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGypCAURVeDGRY8FCUgmMSsJ53QQn0oM0-wgG6nd_-r_xZ-fKvuOXX-POaHCxTi_tudaKtPc8S7ENaKeT5TxiOdmNGH6OKKhbCULYcZBPRcjFx28-YCveeu2axHBFQNWjn0vdS9UdAcFvWGchTOm2VQg0EzSgF6BIF-cdrrJtjPmxhlJ4XolWy7xZllHUBpIQ0axTqBW6gpt39TiPVAT-_0wtyu6WzIHrVehalfDCYG00e_3R3R8_rsDKYrETGYtFFKA4NpyyH-C3Hn2VXkEW9O6eaO1nQk4muKK-ZYeHnmHVtXrv9Nttt1B6JQ9MA6sZ8u0De8_qjYy8JXAAAA___uOoB2). The decline, steeper among women, Republicans, and young adults, comes as a record 53% believe [even moderate drinking is bad](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO3CAQhJ_G7jjBArYpKNJcd2lTWhjW503W4GByp3v7yP8r_OVopNF836_H_AjElJ8_w46-rWXO-D4ZW8M676XiVnasuFIOOeLJeJ6p0gwSrJCTUGZOgfgzmz75FRFQ9-jVaK0arNPQbx6SNClZN4zDIKPSZnJpXceYYJV2ibonf63JSRklpdXqZpbgljiCHqRy6HRnJCZqpd5-F8ptw5U_5YX1Fsves99aO85O_-jg3sE9HBfAVV2hNoqMHdxTpfyH8lMEjmUrLBbEKt6UUTD9_VeqOAqz2DBw24R0KgSYotajTVqmEaZkpjjAFJwEHfrq0_EmZjqHsTPyuQfirzvtWw5fHv4HAAD__4TvhJs) for health. Regular drinkers themselves are cutting back, with weekly averages at a 29-year low of 2.8 drinks. The shift follows mounting research rejecting earlier claims that small amounts of alcohol could be heart-healthy.

The family of flood victim Jayda Floyd, 22, of Odessa, [filed the first lawsuit](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ygzAMx5_GbOYsYyAZPHRhS9eOnECCuDU4ZzsB3r5H-gjdNPz0__q69Td03q3zJy5s8z6FfuUtec6ZY-8xzpxy5h3T5PyS8pNcGMPaa6VrqS4STE_o_NGbguyg6AoFW2jrGpprVbXF3TZIAxMQoNHVREYT14ZRq2bi-opUOHuKqQsYAKXBlMA0tEADjIyDgkoYxeRyiGW-818Wf4QXx3IMS-HtPedHEtWH0J3Q3bZt5RR2c9Y4AaG78xS6e7_KyYdAbp3lD8cox_Bc8yE9bunpsvzGg_BEDiqipcfmvHepaYVR84LOvx3z_3Z6Wf0bAAD___GigKo) related to last month’s flash floods. subject: Democrat Governor Kathy Hochul is trying to rig the next election.
body:
Here is my plan to stop her.

| | | | |
---
Friend, Governor Kathy Hochul revealed how she plans to deliver the House to Democrats next year: **_Gerrymandering the Empire State!_**

[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Let’s be clear, Kathy Hochul and New York Democrats aren’t interested in a fair fight. After the 2020 census Democrats across the country tried to erase as many Republican districts as they could in states where they have one party control.
I led the fight against Hochul’s shameless power grab and we won the legal battle to give voters in New York a real choice on the ballot.
**[Thanks to our work justice prevailed in New York and because of that victory we were able to preserve our current majority in the House that is working with President Trump to deliver his America First agenda.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
But unfortunately that majority is RAZOR THIN because despite our tremendous victory last fall most Democrats run states from Maryland to New Mexico were able to implement their rigged maps.
In Illinois, the state that Texas Dems fled to in protest of their state’s current redistricting process, Democrats ensured that Republicans would only be favored in THREE of their states congressional districts.
In the home state of Abraham Lincoln, our nation’s first Republican president, over 2.5 million votes were cast for House Republicans in last year’s election.

That was 46.9% of IL's congressional votes, yet Democrats rigged the game so that they would still secure 14 seats from a delegation of 17.
Honest Abe would be shocked...

[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Kathy Hochul, the WORST Governor in America, wants to try again to replicate this strategy because she knows that her party has failed New York and wouldn’t win a fair fight.
NY voters already said "_NO_ ". The courts already said "_NO_ "_._
But that isn’t going to stop her from trying again.
Why? Because this isn’t about Texas.
This is about the Democrats’ plan to regain control of Congress by rigging elections against America First candidates in order to silence the American people who reject the Left’s radical agenda.
**_[That’s why this time, they’re pulling out all the stops - an emergency redistricting scheme designed to erase GOP seats before we can even get to Election Day.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_**
Patriot, she’s counting on your silence.
She’s counting on you to be exhausted and think that _this is someone else’s fight_.
But I know that I have been able to count on patriots like you before to stand with me. That’s how we held the line before and with your continued support we’ll do it again.

**_[I’m asking you to chip in right now to the House GOP Battleground Fund to support my efforts to defeat Hochul before it’s too late](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**

[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
[STAND WITH ELISE](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Right now, Democrats are dumping cash into legal teams and dark money groups to help Governor Hochul prevail in this fight.
We can’t afford to blink. There is not a moment to lose to ensure that we have the resources to continue fighting fire with fire.
**_[So please contribute whatever you can today to fund our fight to stop the rigging of New York’s elections](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**
Together we can preserve the GOP House majority and FIRE HOCHUL in 2026.

_For America,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aZiq/?__vbtrk=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzExMjUyOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**Elise Stefanik**
Proud New Yorker

subject: The election no one’s watching
body:
MAGA operatives have figured out that low-information, low-turnout elections are the perfect place to stage a takeover.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hayBGQgCIzLmuMKqNjm4o5TD263tyfo40KoF7-tAJGxC0lE7k0MVEDLi3s-JezmlX8N135whw8mcx-vOYc9TF-KFKjZ0Pi6XoxqS5eGvbsEPoG_71IyrU07TsLL7rICzQvIY2dzLvlTOTTk6q6V1ZcpkJ3RjTlFzG2u_43jMl45B7Ax9AKdSX-Tv9lviFi2KyHE9fOAHZMXGsOvhd5L2yVI-jABCLiLhddJggot1-rs=&c=05Nc96CC-Q_G_LEuFUxyvRq_Xx_n8Ec7SfFCImqRk34-1og8Rj1pgg==&ch=gYbp73nfMhbjMIgxefORrWpu7lTHcweSHCHZxaT19GHJ85LdTj9V0A==)

| Peter,
Most people have never heard of a judicial retention election. And that's exactly why MAGA loves them.
This November, Pennsylvania voters will be asked a simple "Yes" or "No" on whether three Democratic justices should remain on the state Supreme Court. That's it. No debates. No traditional campaigns. No wall-to-wall media coverage.
In most years, turnout for these races is abysmal. Voters skip the question entirely or vote "No" without even knowing who's on the bench.
MAGA operatives have figured out that low-information, low-turnout elections are the perfect place to stage a takeover. They've already begun pouring millions into Pennsylvania, aiming to flip the court and secure a majority that will rule in their favor for the next decade.
Once they have that majority, they can bless gerrymandered maps, uphold voter suppression laws, and block challenges to election interference in 2026 and 2028.
Defend Our Courts exists to shine a light on these overlooked but critical races. We're planning on educating voters, running ads, and organizing early -- because if we wait until the final weeks, we'll be too far behind.
[Will you donate now to help us turn the race no one's watching into the race that saves Pennsylvania's democracy? $25, $50, or $100 goes such a long way in helping us defend our democracy from MAGA's relentless attacks.](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hayBGQgCIzLmuMKqNjm4o5TD263tyfo40KoF7-tAJGxC0lE7k0MVEDLi3s-JezmlX8N135whw8mcx-vOYc9TF-KFKjZ0Pi6XoxqS5eGvbsEPoG_71IyrU07TsLL7rICzQvIY2dzLvlTOTTk6q6V1ZcpkJ3RjTlFzG2u_43jMl45B7Ax9AKdSX-Tv9lviFi2KyHE9fOAHZMXGsOvhd5L2yYC3OR0Ucl7Z1O-PJ6MMoCs=&c=05Nc96CC-Q_G_LEuFUxyvRq_Xx_n8Ec7SfFCImqRk34-1og8Rj1pgg==&ch=gYbp73nfMhbjMIgxefORrWpu7lTHcweSHCHZxaT19GHJ85LdTj9V0A==)

For someone who talks as much as he does about [free speech](https://substack.com/redirect/99387271-a98f-4b86-b7cf-93dd87330f09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), President Trump seems not to respect it much in practice. While the [chasm](https://substack.com/redirect/06cbb62f-017e-4a0e-a180-73a410d7e923?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between his rhetoric and reality should surprise no one, it reached a new low this week with the deployment of federal troops in DC on false pretenses.
Far from advancing any conception of freedom, this deployment instead reeks of martial law. Beyond exposing the president's authoritarian aspirations, it also puts [each](https://substack.com/redirect/ff36bf92-a19a-48d7-87e1-97e58d8dc282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the [other](https://substack.com/redirect/3b3e1e67-a65a-418a-9548-bedfdb3cd7e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) branches of government--which have repeatedly proven themselves complicit in the fascism that too many observers blame [solely](https://substack.com/redirect/30c73f6a-971e-48ff-935b-8f6d85492116?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Trump--to shame.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! You can help inform your friends by sharing this post._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=170964887&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTcwOTY0ODg3LCJpYXQiOjE3NTUxNzIwNTMsImV4cCI6MTc1Nzc2NDA1MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.q8Ek8vxYT5S6RBoi8FnzcxXAdjObezDHMBNh5tMjzV4)
### **Deploying troops in DC**
On Monday, the president [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/787c5cae-2db9-42fd-b30c-cdc9d3c69754?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his plans to deploy National Guard troops to the District of Columbia, and also to take control of the city's police department under the 1973 law ironically known as The District of Columbia [Home Rule Act](https://substack.com/redirect/52d5c71e-c173-4c74-a5e8-26cfcf762d18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/576f6821-ebc1-4ea0-ad99-2b72411c6a0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As troops [began arriving on Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/84622265-f912-451d-a1ae-154b2c7f2e32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), disturbing reports emerged about violations of civil rights and civil liberties en masse, apparently related to arrests for offenses as severe as [subway fare evasion](https://substack.com/redirect/be181f2d-7108-4bfb-a641-9b163c609b7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and arresting an assailant on felony charges who allegedly [assaulted](https://substack.com/redirect/b56a9e6d-0618-45e0-b1be-0fc407b79109?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a police officer using a sandwich as a weapon.
Many voices have noted that the president's pretext for deploying troops was a supposed crime wave that he appears to have [invented](https://substack.com/redirect/f0812b61-b291-46f8-aedc-ee01f536365e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), perhaps inspired by television crime dramas. In fact, violent crime in the nation's capital has declined substantially in recent years, while the president appears to have opportunistically cited [injuries sustained by a DOGE staffer](https://substack.com/redirect/70e2fed7-9544-4744-8ca5-c52990d77762?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during a recent carjacking as a basis to reject reality and instead project his own.
It's also worth noting the recurrence of a pattern across time. According to USA Today, "The last time troops were deployed in Washington, D.C., [happened during Trump's first term in 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/edce28a2-192f-4a24-bf4e-7dee4e6a4d96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to suppress protests sparked by the police murder of George Floyd."
It wasn't OK then, either--or when he repeated that [abusive pattern in Los Angeles](https://substack.com/redirect/a03c4b49-7c6e-4e87-9552-e270723411ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a few weeks ago.
### **Sending a message far beyond DC**
While announcing his decision to impose [martial law](https://substack.com/redirect/d7a8a897-179c-4147-8578-f9fecf7dab32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in DC (however [apologists](https://substack.com/redirect/edce28a2-192f-4a24-bf4e-7dee4e6a4d96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) might alternatively describe the deployment of federal troops immune from local oversight or accountability), Trump also telegraphed his plans to do the same elsewhere.
He specifically [named](https://substack.com/redirect/1b3c9b05-19c2-43cf-a77c-46d928c81230?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Chicago and Oakland, after having previously deployed federal troops to suppress constitutionally protected dissent in cities including [Portland](https://substack.com/redirect/5eb478e6-0f58-402c-9d98-04983dc3012b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
One might be comforted by the fact that [Congress passed a law in 1878](https://substack.com/redirect/1b3c9b05-19c2-43cf-a77c-46d928c81230?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to limit the executive branch's ability to deploy the military domestically, or for law enforcement purposes. But the Posse Comitatus Act does not restrain the use of the National Guard for such purposes.
Although deployments of National Guard troops generally happen only with the approval of a state's Governor, the District of Columbia [has no Governor](https://substack.com/redirect/f816a8a3-b3be-41f5-90ec-bcf5e14f295d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and thus stands more vulnerable to the president's whims. Residents of DC--historically, a majority Black city--have been [denied federal representation](https://substack.com/redirect/0f7af4ae-c252-4ded-a030-2b97e082e436?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) since the city's founding.

### **It gets worse**
On Wednesday, Trump announced his further plans to ask Congress for additional authorization to control DC's police force [beyond the 30 days allowed](https://substack.com/redirect/0952a280-0234-4a89-8e7b-7bd85984006d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) under the law currently. Given how far Congress has [bent over backwards](https://substack.com/redirect/f2cae4ee-53be-4009-8a90-3febeaece637?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to accommodate the whims of presidents, no one should feel safe.
Law-abiding people have been subjected to [arbitrary state violence](https://substack.com/redirect/f4c96b3f-6e44-4599-8444-d1cbfb9d7667?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), spreading precisely the sense of unease and insecurity that the president falsely attributed to street crime.
Even worse, these impositions on fundamental constitutional rights come with no benefit. The strategies and tactics used by federal agencies and National Guard troops in DC were largely [pioneered](https://substack.com/redirect/9144bcd6-fb2a-41a3-8836-815eb2e8cef5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the context of military occupations abroad--where they notoriously failed.
As [explained](https://substack.com/redirect/c025fe32-972f-4efb-9bfa-0f05bebd9973?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Maryland Governor Wes Moore, "Our National Guards are not trained for this ... we know the missions that they are trained for. Municipal policing is not one of them. If we want to be serious about making people safe, let's actually do the things that make people safe."
### **More to be written**
When I started writing this article, I envisioned connecting the imposition of martial law in DC to various related themes, including: the recent legislative expansion of ICE; the president's recent and ongoing betrayals of veterans, many of whom work in law enforcement; and the irony of Trump's appeal to law enforcement after pardoning rioters who attacked and injured police officers.
But the sun is about to rise and I need to go to work, so I'll save those topics for another time, hopefully soon.

The president mouths rhetoric about "freedom," while degrading it from DC to LA | | | Aug 14 | | | | | | | | | | | | For someone who talks as much as he does about , President Trump seems not to respect it much in practice. While the between his rhetoric and reality should surprise no one, it reached a new low this week with the deployment of federal troops in DC on false pretenses. Far from advancing any conception of freedom, this deployment instead reeks of martial law. Beyond exposing the president's authoritarian aspirations, it also puts of the branches of government--which have repeatedly proven themselves complicit in the fascism that too many observers blame on Trump--to shame. Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! You can help inform your friends by sharing this post. Deploying troops in DC On Monday, the president his plans to deploy National Guard troops to the District of Columbia, and also to take control of the city's police department under the 1973 law ironically known as The District of Columbia . | | ---|---|--- As troops , disturbing reports emerged about violations of civil rights and civil liberties en masse, apparently related to arrests for offenses as severe as and arresting an assailant on felony charges who allegedly a police officer using a sandwich as a weapon. Many voices have noted that the president's pretext for deploying troops was a supposed crime wave that he appears to have , perhaps inspired by television crime dramas. In fact, violent crime in the nation's capital has declined substantially in recent years, while the president appears to have opportunistically cited during a recent carjacking as a basis to reject reality and instead project his own. It's also worth noting the recurrence of a pattern across time. According to USA Today, "The last time troops were deployed in Washington, D.C., to suppress protests sparked by the police murder of George Floyd." It wasn't OK then, either--or when he repeated that a few weeks ago. Sending a message far beyond DC While announcing his decision to impose in DC (however might alternatively describe the deployment of federal troops immune from local oversight or accountability), Trump also telegraphed his plans to do the same elsewhere. He specifically Chicago and Oakland, after having previously deployed federal troops to suppress constitutionally protected dissent in cities including . One might be comforted by the fact that to limit the executive branch's ability to deploy the military domestically, or for law enforcement purposes. But the Posse Comitatus Act does not restrain the use of the National Guard for such purposes. Although deployments of National Guard troops generally happen only with the approval of a state's Governor, the District of Columbia and thus stands more vulnerable to the president's whims. Residents of DC--historically, a majority Black city--have been since the city's founding. Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,sign up for a free subscription! Paid subscriptions help expand my work. It gets worse On Wednesday, Trump announced his further plans to ask Congress for additional authorization to control DC's police force under the law currently. Given how far Congress has to accommodate the whims of presidents, no one should feel safe. Law-abiding people have been subjected to , spreading precisely the sense of unease and insecurity that the president falsely attributed to street crime. Even worse, these impositions on fundamental constitutional rights come with no benefit. The strategies and tactics used by federal agencies and National Guard troops in DC were largely in the context of military occupations abroad--where they notoriously failed. As by Maryland Governor Wes Moore, "Our National Guards are not trained for this ... we know the missions that they are trained for. Municipal policing is not one of them. If we want to be serious about making people safe, let's actually do the things that make people safe." More to be written When I started writing this article, I envisioned connecting the imposition of martial law in DC to various related themes, including: the recent legislative expansion of ICE; the president's recent and ongoing betrayals of veterans, many of whom work in law enforcement; and the irony of Trump's appeal to law enforcement after pardoning rioters who attacked and injured police officers. Friend,

They wave the American flag. They chant _" USA!" _at the top of their lungs.They walk out of our events ready to fight for faith, family, and freedom.

These kids were supposed to be the generation that gave up on America...But instead? **_They 're falling in love with her all over again._**That's not hype...That's what's happening.Right now. On college campuses. In deep-blue states. In places the Left thought they owned.And let me be clear: It's not just happening because of me... **It 's happening because patriots like you are stepping up. Because you've chosen to stand up and say: "We're not losing this country."**You're the reason we can show up and speak boldly on college campuses. You're the reason students feel the courage to stand up for their country.You're the reason this movement is catching fire across America. But Friend, I don't want you to just watch this revolution from the sidelines...I want you to help drive it.To push it further. To wake up even more campuses and young hearts and minds. To CRACK every last one of the Left's strongholds...And help us DEFEAT the Left in the American Culture War. **That 's why today, when you make your gift in any amount to Turning Point USA...****I 'll send you a limited-edition "47" hat -- the same one students are BEGGING for on campus -- as my personal thank-you.**_Not because you need a hat ... _But because you deserve a reminder in your hands that says: _" I helped build this. I stood up when it counted. I helped SAVE my country."_

These kids are PROUD to be American.**That's the country I know you and I love. That's the movement we're building. _And I 'm asking YOU to be part of it right now, when it matters most..._Because if we don't go BIGGER... If we don't seize this momentum with everything we've got......the Left will come roaring back.They're already plotting. Already mobilizing. Already trying to take back the ground they've lost.But we can't let them.Not now. clean_body: Will you give $25 or another amount today so we can reach undecided voters? = Peter, it looks like you haven't yet donated to my campaign, so I'll cut right to the chase: I'm counting on your $25 contribution today. Our campaign set an ambitious fundraising goal to flip Virginia blue and needs a few more donors from your area to step up before our mid-month deadline. = = = = = = = According to the polls, many Virginians have not yet decided who they'll support in this race. Some may see that as a challenge, but I see an incredible opportunity. As the Democratic nominee in Virginia, the only state where we can flip a governorship this year, I won't settle for a modest victory. I want to win big, and I want to set an example for Democrats in 2026, 2028, and beyond. But my opponent Winsome Earle-Sears has lined up far-right groups to foot the bill for attack ads across our Commonwealth. So, I need your help to respond: Will you help us keep our own ads on the air? = = Thank you, Abigail Spanberger By submitting your phone number you're agreeing to receive periodic text messages from the Spanberger for Governor campaign. # Putin praises Trump as "sincere," suggests possible U.S./Russia nuclear arms deal
Russian President Vladimir Putin **[reportedly told senior officials Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/3ecd5053-08af-4074-8292-3eda44446e37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that the current American administration is making "quite energetic and sincere efforts to stop the hostilities, stop the crisis and reach agreements that are of interest to all parties involved in this conflict."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e5fcc9f8-6923-4ddc-9090-62d6c336175e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Russia suggests nuclear arms control deal could facilitate peace** \- Putin indicated that a possible peace agreement could emerge if the US and Russia can "reach agreements in the area of control over strategic offensive weapons," referencing nuclear arms control measures ahead of upcoming meetings in Anchorage, Alaska.
* **New START nuclear treaty set to expire in February 2026** \- The 2011 New START pact, which limits each country to 1,550 deployed nuclear warheads and 700 deployed missiles and bombers, expires February 5, 2026, and has been "on life support" since Putin announced Russia would no longer comply with its requirements in February.
* **Trump expresses frustration with Putin despite diplomatic overtures** \- While Putin appeared optimistic about potential agreements, Trump has grown increasingly frustrated with the Russian dictator, accusing him of manipulation and saying "We get a lot of bulls-t thrown at us by Putin" despite Putin being "very nice all of the time" but in ways that "turn out to be meaningless."

It led her to take safety precautions and request security for her home and at her son’s elementary school after someone sent a threat about the school.

"Inflation is taxation without legislation," Milton Friedman
Lower taxes are not merely a political slogan but a cornerstone of sound economic theory, promoting growth by enhancing individual incentives and resource allocation. Classical economists like Adam Smith laid the groundwork in "The Wealth of Nations," arguing that minimal government interference, including low taxes, allows markets to flourish.
But modern theorists like Milton Friedman and Friedrich Hayek refined this, emphasizing how taxes distort behavior. Friedman, in his advocacy for free markets, highlighted that high taxes penalize success. He noted, "Inflation is taxation without legislation," but extended this to direct taxes, arguing they reduce savings and investment.
Lower rates, he posited, stimulate entrepreneurship by leaving more capital in private hands, leading to job creation and innovation. Empirical data supports this: tax cuts in the 1980s under Reagan increased real GDP growth from 2.5% to over 4% annually.
The Laffer Curve, popularized by economist Arthur Laffer, provides a mathematical rationale. It illustrates that beyond a certain point, higher tax rates reduce revenue as people work less, evade taxes, or relocate. Laffer stated, "When the tax rate is zero percent, government will collect nothing... When the tax rate is 100 percent, government will also collect nothing."
Optimal rates maximize revenue while minimizing disincentives. Reagan's cuts validated this, with federal revenues rising 28% from 1983 to 1989 despite lower rates.
Hayek, another Nobel winner, linked low taxes to freedom, warning that progressive taxation erodes liberty. He wrote, "The system of private property is the most important guaranty of freedom," implying taxes undermine property rights and voluntary cooperation.
High taxes force inefficient allocations, as government spending lacks market signals, leading to waste. Murray Rothbard took a radical libertarian stance, viewing taxes as immoral and economically destructive. He argued, "The best way to help the poor is to slash taxes and allow savings, investment, and creation of jobs to proceed unhampered."
Rothbard contended that taxes transfer wealth from productive sectors to bureaucracy, stifling innovation. Studies show that a 1% GDP tax increase can lower growth by 2-3%.
Supply-side economics integrates these ideas, positing that lower taxes boost supply through increased labor participation and capital formation. Corporate tax cuts, for instance, encourage investment; post-2017, U.S. business investment rose 9%.
Critics argue cuts favor the rich, but evidence shows broader benefits: wage growth accelerates as firms compete for workers.
Lower taxes also reduce evasion and black markets, broadening the tax base.In essence, these theories demonstrate that lower taxes foster a virtuous cycle of growth, where individuals retain earnings, invest wisely, and drive prosperity. High taxes, by contrast, create deadweight losses, discouraging the very activities that build wealth.

VFAF Endorses Jim Marchant for Congress

---
| Peter,
---
I am honored to announce that Veterans for America First has officially endorsed my campaign for Nevada's 1st Congressional District. "When it comes to the MAGA movement in Nevada, it is synonymous with Jim Marchant," said Jared Craig, Vice President of Veterans for America First. "VFAF will be making a few early select congressional endorsements, and Jim is one of them."
---
|
---
This endorsement means a great deal to me. VFAF represents the courage, sacrifice, and patriotism of those who have worn our nation's uniform. These are men and women who have put everything on the line for our freedoms, and now they are standing with us to take the fight to Washington. I have never wavered in my commitment to: • Secure our border • Protect our constitutional freedoms • Restore election integrity • Put the people of Nevada first VFAF's trust is a sign that our campaign is gaining momentum, but we cannot slow down now. The radical left and entrenched political class are determined to hold onto power, no matter the cost. Thank you for standing with me and with Veterans for America First. Together, we will take our country back.
---

name: PoliticsPA
subject: State Budget Stuck in Holding Pattern
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason. | | | |
---
| | |
---
| "Forward" by Tim Hartman
---
| Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ , featuring a special update on the PA State Budget.
---
|
* * *
---
| **Still waiting for a signed budget...
45 days later**
---
| The Pennsylvania state budget is over six weeks late, and lawmakers remain at odds about funding for several categories, including education and public transit. The Republican-majority Senate passed a version this week, but it seems unlikely that the Democratic-majority House will approve it. The Senate Republicans are calling on the House to pass the budget, and the House Democrats are threatening to reject it to get lawmakers back to the table and reach a reasonable compromise. For now, the budget remains at an impasse.
---
|
* * *
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Senate Democratic Leader Jay Costa and Democratic Appropriations Chair Vince Hughes **shared in a statement their opinion that “Senate Republicans had the opportunity to move the ball forward and take real steps towards solving some of Pennsylvania’s biggest problems. Instead, we got ridiculous, unserious schemes that fail to meet the scale, scope, and urgency of the transit crisis facing our commonwealth." [[PASenate](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=149e214902&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**PA House Republican Leader Jesse Topper** , published a press release arguing that “the solutions to the incredible challenges we face as a Commonwealth will only be found when all parties engage in meaningful ways and acknowledge the serious problems confronting us in resolving this budget: SEPTA is in crisis. Our state’s education system, in many respects, is in crisis. Our state’s economic outlook is in crisis.” [[PAHouseGOP](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0cf5b432b8&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
|
* On August 12, 2025, the PA State Senate passed the 2025–2026 budget bill — six weeks late — maintaining last year’s spending level of **$47.6 billion**. [[PhiladelphiaInquirer](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c4d936ab9a&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* On August 12, 2025, the PA State Senate passed the 2025–2026 budget bill — six weeks late — maintaining last year’s spending level of **$47.6 billion**. [[CommonwealthFoundation](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7dd8aec42b&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Over the next two years, the transit [House Bill 257](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0545111bbe&e=b7b3eddce2) allocates **$419 million** from the capital portion of the Public Transportation Trust Fund, along with **$173 million** from gaming-tax revenues, to support public transit projects and services. [[City&State](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=50a32efbd3&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* In Delaware County, home to about **576,000 residents** , only two hospitals — Riddle and Mercy Fitzgerald — are still operating, down from six just a few years ago. [[B+L](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=64b8cfa1f0&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **News You Need to Know**
---
| **Chief Investigative Reporter Todd Shepherd** , recently reported that “Governor Josh Shapiro continues to cooperate with a voter registration website with a web address deceptively similar to the official Pennsylvania Department of State’s, but which also harvests the registrant’s personal information for partisan political advertising.” [[B+L](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8f8ac0a4d0&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7603c2e1c2&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=34497dbc3d&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d8652d57df&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f77857cf7f&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=dad94b6e36&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

Friend, Donald Trump lies – plain and simple.
Sometimes he bends the truth beyond recognition. Sometimes he bulldozes right over it. But the effect is always the same: a deliberate erosion of trust in the institutions that hold our democracy together. And now, he's doing it again.
**Firing the head of the Bureau of Labor Statistics** for supposedly "rigging" job numbers with no evidence at all. A trusted, nonpartisan public servant gets smeared for simply doing her job. Why? Because the facts didn't suit Trump's delusional political narrative. And whom does he nominate to replace her? A crony from the Heritage Foundation who has publicly attacked that very same Bureau of Labor Statistics whenever the data does not fit the MAGA ideology.
**Attacking Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell** and constantly pressuring him for deep interest rate cuts – making claims that our economy is "booming" even as Trump's sky-high tariffs leave businesses unable to plan and American citizens uncertain about what the future may hold.
**Claiming his mass deportations target only "the worst of the worst"** when, in actuality, children and families with no criminal record whatsoever are being abducted and sent away. A high school junior from Wilbur Cross in New Haven is sitting in a detention center instead of preparing for the school year. An Afghan interpreter who volunteered at risk to his own life (and that of his family) to help **_our U.S._** military men and women stay safe during that conflict and was promised safe haven here in thanks for that service, and instead is being held by ICE. Deporting these individuals serves no purpose and no one’s interest. Except Donald Trump’s interest. And ego.
**These aren't isolated incidents, friend. They're part of a pattern. Trump wants to break the public's trust in the government so he can remake it in his own image. He's chipping away at the facts, institutions, and accountability to serve himself – and only himself.**
As your Senator, I'm not going to let that stand. Not now, not ever. But I need you with me.

| Dear Peter, Elon Musk’s DOGE scheme was allegedly going to root out government waste. Instead, it literally torched taxpayer dollars, resulted in massive federal layoffs, and cut funding to vital programs and research. Now, after a mean _girls_ -style public breakup with Trump, Musk wants a new sweetheart deal for him and his investors. Who better to take advantage of than a starry eyed, fanboy like Bill Lee? Let’s be honest - Lee, no stranger to secret privatization deals, was an easy target. Lee is giving Musk and his Boring Company state property for 50 years to use century-old technology to dig a tunnel to operate an underground taxi service — with no oversight, regulation or price controls and zero public input or transparency. This tunnel isn’t an “innovative” solution for public transit. The Boring Company’s so-called Vegas Loop was a congested, single-lane death trap that OSHA flagged for serious workplace safety violations. **Now Tennessee Republicans** **— including Gov. Massey —** **are threatening Nashville’s underground** **infrastructure for another Musk boondoggle** while our neighbors face skyrocketing grocery prices, brutal cuts to SNAP and TennCare, and an ever-growing healthcare and childcare crisis.

subject: We have a lot of data now, and it paints a difficult picture

body:
Wishful thinking won’t save us, Peter
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93589?refcode=em20250814-9259&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9259%2E614464%2EX8YDLh)
Peter, too often when campaigns face cold, hard data showing a tough road ahead, they turn a blind eye. It’s one of the reasons Democrats are where we are today.
I’m determined not to repeat the mistakes of the past. So I’m going to share with you the truth about what the data is showing about our race here in New Jersey. I’m also going to share my plan for how we overcome the obstacles and win. And then, if you’re all in on beating Jack Ciattarelli and preventing New Jersey from falling into the hands of a MAGA loyalist, I’m going to ask you to **[split what you can between my team and Heartland Patriots to help me put that plan into action.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93589?refcode=em20250814-9259&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9259%2E614464%2EX8YDLh)**
**Here’s an unvarnished look at what the data tells us:**
**→Polling.** Since the general election began a few weeks ago, one poll after another has come out showing me with a small lead (often just 3-6%) over Jack Ciattarelli — with more than enough undecided voters to swing the outcome either way.
And that’s not even taking into account the possibility that the polls could be underestimating Republicans, Peter, as they have in several recent elections. We need to campaign like we’re behind — _because we may well be._
**→Recent elections.** The 2024 presidential race in New Jersey was decided by less than 6% The last governor’s race here? Decided by just 3%. Recent election results and recent polls all tell the same story: _New Jersey is a battleground state._
**→Attack ads.** Ciattarelli’s super PAC has announced plans to spend over a million dollars attacking me across New Jersey, with plenty more planned in the weeks ahead. One recent poll found that after undecided voters heard these false attacks without a fact-check, _they swung heavily in Ciattarelli’s direction._
**Here’s what this all means, Peter: we are in an incredibly competitive race, and we will only win it if we work night and day to get our message out all across New Jersey. And that’s exactly what my team and I plan to do.**
We need to get out of the usual Democratic comfort zone and show up everywhere so that voters can actually hear what we have to say.
We need to blanket the state with our plan for lowering costs and making daily life easier for New Jersey families.
We need to reach out personally to undecided voters — and make sure every single one of our supporters shows up to vote this fall.
And it won’t be enough to fight Ciattarelli and his dark-money machine to a draw. We need to outhustle, outwork, and outsmart them every step of the way.
**[Peter, I’m all in on winning this race for the people of New Jersey. I’ve spent my life running toward tough fights, and I won’t hesitate to run toward this one. If you’re with me, I need your support. Please split whatever you can between my campaign and Heartland Patriots to help us win what is shaping up to be a nail-biter of a race.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93589?refcode=em20250814-9259&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=9259%2E614464%2EX8YDLh)**

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: 🏠 A BIG win for housing in Houston / Una GRAN victoria para la vivienda en Houston 🏠
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
COMMUNITY WIN:
Securing $100 million for housing in Houston's disaster recovery plan
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NL%20-%202025%20Houston%20disaster%20recovery%20voteJPG.JPG]
ORGANIZING VICTORY: Houston City Council on Wednesday voted to submit Mayor Whitmire’s disaster recovery plan for 2024’s Hurricane Beryl and the Derecho to the federal government, with an allocation of $100 million in the plan now dedicated to housing.
It was intensive community organizing from TOP and our Houston housing justice allies West Street Recovery, Texas Housers, Texas Appleseed, Just Climate Resilience for Climate & Energy, Northeast Action Collective, and the Coalition for the Environment, Equity and Resilience, that made this $100 million possible in the City's final disaster recovery funding plan.
Read more about the win here. [https://communityimpact.com/houston/heights-river-oaks-montrose/government/2025/08/13/houston-approves-314m-federal-disaster-aid-plan-prioritizing-funds-toward-housing-backup-generators/]
Houston residents loudly and consistently spoke up on this matter, reminding our city elected leaders that community members weren’t about to accept the $0 allocated toward housing that was in the initial disaster recovery plan. It was truly grassroots organizing that secured this much-needed win.
TOP and allies now look forward to this plan being implemented in full in the months to come, with accountability and transparency on how funding dollars will be spent.
For more information on this community organizing win, contact Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
SATURDAY IN AUSTIN:
Keeping up the pressure against Trump and Abbott's redistricting scheme
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20Capitol%20redistricting%20protest%202025.jpg]
With Texas House Democrats continuing to break quorum, more and more Texans are starting to see this abrupt congressional redistricting push for what it truly is: a Trump takeover of our state.
Upset that their unconstitutional redistricting scheme is being called out on the national stage, Abbott and Texas Republicans are fuming and have been issuing empty threats [https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/news/politics/2025/08/12/528487/lawsuits-arrest-warrants-everything-to-know-about-the-texas-quorum-break/] for the past week to these quorum-breakers who are rightfully denying passage of these discriminatory redistricting maps. Keeping up this momentum is crucial, especially with Abbott now promising another special session to ram through rigged maps [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2025-08-12/texas-greg-abbott-legislature-democrats-quorum-break] .
Join TOP and Texas For All partners this Saturday in Austin, as we raise our voices outside our state Capitol in opposition to this racist redistricting plan.
REGISTER for Saturday’s rally in Austin and SHARE with your friends and family. [https://www.mobilize.us/fightthetrumptakeover/event/824964/]
It's crunch time. We need to show up strong to collectively push back against this MAGA authoritarianism.
Also, CHECK OUT this protest against the Trump takeover this Thursday, if you're in the Dallas area [https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/827214/] .
To learn more about how you can get involved in our fight against Republicans' redistricting efforts, contact David at dvillalobos@organizetexas.org [dvillalobos@organizetexas.org] .
SAN ANTONIO:
Brunch and brainstorm with our probation reform campaign this weekend
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Probation%20event%20Bexar%20County%202025.png]
Bexar County's probation system can and should be reformed to better serve residents while keeping us safe.
Join TOP this Saturday, August 16th, from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m. in San Antonio, as we brainstorm over brunch to make local policy changes, so that more Bexar County residents can successfully complete probation as a rehabilitative experience, allowing them to more freely contribute to the well-being of our families and communities.
Seats are limited, so email Michael N. at mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] or Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] to receive the event location and to RSVP.
Together, let's fight for a local probation system that works fairly for EVERYONE — no matter race, age, gender, or background.
TOP Tip: Get ahead of COVID this school year
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Latino%20School%20bus%20family.jpg]
Millions of Texas students have returned to the classroom to start the fall semester. Just as the latest COVID summer spike has shown, the virus is still active in our communities , meaning we have to keep our guard up and continue to look out for the health of others. Here's what parents should know about COVID as kids head back to school. [https://www.kens5.com/article/news/health/covid-san-antonio-texas-summer-surge-new-school-year/273-05029629-a65f-486a-98aa-4f533e4b4f13]
Español
GANANCIA DE LA COMUNIDAD:
Se garantizan $100 millones para viviendas en el plan de recuperación ante desastres de Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/NL%20-%202025%20Houston%20disaster%20recovery%20voteJPG.JPG]
VICTORIA ORGANIZATIVA: El miércoles, el Concejo Municipal de Houston votó para enviar al gobierno federal el plan de recuperación por desastre del alcalde Whitmire para el huracán Beryl de 2024 y el “Derecho”, con una asignación de 100 millones de dólares destinada ahora a vivienda.
La intensa organización comunitaria de TOP y nuestros aliados en la justicia de vivienda de Houston, West Street Recovery, Texas Housers, Texas Appleseed, Just Climate Resilience for Climate & Energy, Northeast Action Collective, y Coalition for the Environment, Equity and Resilience, hizo posible la asignación de $100 millones del plan final de financiación para la recuperación ante desastres de la ciudad.
Lea sobre esto aquí. [https://communityimpact.com/houston/heights-river-oaks-montrose/government/2025/08/13/houston-approves-314m-federal-disaster-aid-plan-prioritizing-funds-toward-housing-backup-generators/]
Los residentes de Houston alzaron la voz de manera fuerte y constante, recordando a nuestros líderes electos que la comunidad no iba a aceptar los $0 destinados a vivienda que aparecían en el plan inicial de recuperación por desastre. Fue verdaderamente la organización de base la que aseguró esta victoria tan necesaria.
TOP y sus aliados esperan con ansias que este plan se implemente por completo en los próximos meses, con rendición de cuentas y transparencia sobre cómo se gastarán los fondos.
Para más información sobre este logro de organización comunitaria, contacte a Damaris en dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
SÁBADO EN AUSTIN:
Manteniendo la presión contra el plan de redistribución de distritos de Trump y Abbott
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20Capitol%20redistricting%20protest%202025.jpg]
Con los demócratas de la Cámara de Representantes de Texas rompiendo el quórum, cada vez más tejanos comienzan a ver este abrupto intento de redistribución de distritos por parte del Congreso como lo que realmente es: una toma de control de nuestro estado por parte de Trump.
Molestos por el cuestionamiento nacional de su plan inconstitucional de redistribución de distritos, Abbott y los republicanos de Texas están furiosos y llevan la última semana lanzando amenazas vacías [https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/news/politics/2025/08/12/528487/lawsuits-arrest-warrants-everything-to-know-about-the-texas-quorum-break/] contra quienes rompen el quórum y niegan con razón la aprobación de estos mapas discriminatorios de redistribución. Mantener este impulso es crucial, especialmente ahora que Abbott promete otra sesión especial para aprobar a la fuerza los mapas manipulados. [https://www.keranews.org/texas-news/2025-08-12/texas-greg-abbott-legislature-democrats-quorum-break]
Únase a TOP y a los socios de Texas For All este sábado en Austin, para alzar la voz frente al Capitolio estatal en oposición a este plan racista de redistribución de distritos.
INSCRÍBASE en la manifestación del sábado en Austin y COMPARTA con sus amigos y familiares. [https://www.mobilize.us/fightthetrumptakeover/event/824964/]
Es hora de la verdad. Necesitamos presentarnos con fuerza para oponernos colectivamente a este autoritarismo MAGA.
Además, REVISA esta protesta contra la toma de control de Trump este jueves, si estás en el área de Dallas. [https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/827214/]
Para saber más sobre cómo puedes participar en nuestra lucha contra los intentos republicanos de redistribución de distritos, contacta con David en dvillalobos@organizetexas.org [dvillalobos@organizetexas.org] .
SAN ANTONIO:

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Probation%20launch%20event%20Bexar%20County%202025.png]

name: Elizabeth Nader
subject: MORE one-party control?
body:
Peter, Been hearing the rumblings about redistricting in New Jersey and other “blue” states? Governor Phil Murphy has yet to rule out following Governor Gavin Newsom's threats to redraw
| | [ ]()
---
Peter, Been hearing the rumblings about redistricting in New Jersey and other “blue” states? Governor Phil Murphy has [yet to rule](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/e381fd89d9fb18093d210462a1a2d437/eJyNkE1PwzAMhv9Lzg3VOja03qZpmqqOHRCcUUjNFmidyHFgZep_x-VjJyZxsSz78fvaPikGNMhVo0p15I-imKpMEVgXHCCvPLKxX91idj2ZTjLVOnzdkE9Blac_h8_AWL5ZzIpMcR9AkPu75aqudpvHbbWrhQyGxONfOvNFMT_rrG-X1VYNw0Vh6Byv30Q7qpIpwXhR4-QqfqBW-ANziGWeI7y_AEXo961_givru3wEI5OzDvd5lygcet14iMiaUgvaJ0l-GRZIm6gZjhKtad2zJ3RGW4_RNUBaHHRnQsxlKxMCYPPz0hr6792GT9Zpg-8=) out following Governor Gavin Newsom's threats to redraw district lines to give the Left MORE seats of power. Okay, but can we stop copying California already?! It’s like a race to the bottom. I think we can agree that more one party control is the LAST thing we need here in New Jersey. Let’s remember that one party holds 9 of our 12 congressional seats _already_. And both the [Constitution](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/a074ba9f060f2e7ba9c5cde5a2553d73/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnEXRzMhbhIhYHqLOsehQWzYuu2Nm4X9v-6BTQbdh5plneOcGjCSIswpiuPA1CEbggMZSKonE84ZYlM9pMA79ke9ALemY6qZVEN--Ln-AR3syHYcOcK_QIuvVbJ5nRbpdZEVuSSW0vfGXJ5oG0ceTLGfZAobhpxhPkpOzdRuIWbf4SFRJm4o3urb8nlmZ2PO6rnPpUOPONSwYbe22xisbMiy5ZdmQlQmlkKr3J3LsX8rhDukXZ5k=) and the law would have to be changed (unless the Left wants to just ignore the Constitution and the law - and we wouldn’t put it past them) since New Jersey’s Constitution specifies redistricting to occur every 10 years. Murphy says redistricting will be “high on the agenda” for Democratic governors. What SHOULD be high on their list?
* Perhaps reducing our tax burden.
* Perhaps a balanced budget.
* Perhaps ending the protests against the deportation of violent criminals.
* Perhaps ensuring students can read and write.
* Perhaps making it easier to start a business.
* Perhaps taking real action on crime.

But no. Holding on to political power and grabbing more of it will always be their #1 concern. And so common sense remains dead. Imagine how much more difficult it will be to reverse the direction of our state locally and federally if one party gains 100% control... But we can’t count ourselves out as the Common Sense Majority – even if _they_ do. If these power grabbers proceed with this perversion of the process, you can bet we will have something to say about it. For New Jersey,
