body:
#

_Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024.
And this Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– please rush $5 to my re-election campaign today.
**Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-august25.AuYWG3&refcode=em250814-1-f&t=1&akid=622%2E5691347%2EgL3MIW)
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.
* Handed sweeping, unaccountable power to the billionaire who spent $300 million to elect him.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we _will_ win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please make a contribution to my re-election campaign today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-august25.AuYWG3&refcode=em250814-1-f&t=2&akid=622%2E5691347%2EgL3MIW)
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today.
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-august25.AuYWG3&refcode=em250814-1-f&t=3&akid=622%2E5691347%2EgL3MIW)**
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff
[
---

name: Wes Moore
subject: What Trump is doing with the National Guard
body:
[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1001&akid=455%2E1086043%2E8fOldh ]Wes Moore for Governor[ https://act.wesmoore.com/go/9?t=1002&akid=455%2E1086043%2E8fOldh ]Wes Moore for Governor

Donald Trump’s decision to deploy the National Guard in D.C. is deeply
dangerous, Peter.

As someone who has served this country overseas and who is
commander-in-chief of the Maryland National Guard, I take this very
seriously.

Donald Trump’s policies have raised unemployment, made people lose their
healthcare, and cut food assistance for children. Now he’s using
citizen-soldiers as a distraction and as a cudgel to advance his own
political purposes.

If he really wanted to address the issue of crime, he should look at what
we’re doing in Maryland.

We’ve helped to lead the country in drops in violent crime, shootings, and
carjackings. Our number one priority is making sure people feel safe in
their communities — and our policies, from investing in law enforcement to
investing in community violence prevention, reflect that priority.

Instead, Donald Trump and his administration are not treating our
government resources and the people who choose to serve in our National
Guard with the seriousness they deserve.

I’m embarrassed, I’m angered, and I’m heartbroken by these political
games. Our servicemembers should not be used as a tool for advancing
anyone’s agenda — and as
Maryland's Governor, I
will not use our servicemembers for a political ploy.

so I can continue leading Maryland forward.

Thank you,
Peter.

subject: Trump South Carolina State Director Joins Nancy Mace for Governor
body:
Austin McCubbin, a proven strategist and longtime Trump ally, returns to Team Mace | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/nancymace/trump-south-carolina-state-director-joins-nancy-mace-for-governor?e=ddc57b5ede)

| | **TRUMP SOUTH CAROLINA STATE DIRECTOR JOINS NANCY MACE FOR GOVERNOR**
Nancy Mace for Governor announced today **Austin McCubbin** , a proven strategist and longtime Trump ally, is returning to Team Mace as one of her lead consultants.

McCubbin managed Mace’s first re-election in 2022, delivering an 8-point victory in one of the most competitive Republican congressional primaries in the country. His return underscores Mace’s commitment to the America First agenda.
---
|
---
| “Nancy Mace worked for President Trump before it was cool,” **said McCubbin.** “There isn’t a more formidable candidate in this race with a longer history of supporting President Trump, and I couldn’t be more enthusiastic about teaming up with Nancy for another historic win.”
---
| [Donate](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=3c6661db94&e=ddc57b5ede "Donate")
---
| Trump Co-Campaign Manager Chris LaCivita, who served as Nancy Mace’s media consultant in 2022, recruited McCubbin to serve as the South Carolina State Director for Team Trump in April 2023. In that role, McCubbin led the state to secure more endorsements than any other early-voting state and built a grassroots army that delivered a decisive 20-point victory over former South Carolina Governor Nikki Haley. James Blair, now a White House Deputy Chief of Staff, brought McCubbin onto his senior political team at Trump Campaign Headquarters in West Palm Beach in January 2024. “Working for President Trump in his historic 2024 win has been the honor of my lifetime,” **said McCubbin.** “Nancy Mace will be the most pro-Trump and America First governor in the country, and we will work tirelessly to make sure South Carolina’s best days are ahead of us.”
---
| [Donate](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=066d5d800e&e=ddc57b5ede "Donate")
---
| McCubbin has been in politics for over three decades, starting as a volunteer on his first congressional campaign in 1994. His career includes serving as Body Man and Director of Advance for Governor Ernie Fletcher (2005–2007), a DoD contractor in Iraq (2008–2009), and campaign manager for Andy Barr’s successful 2010 primary. He also served as a fundraising consultant for Senator Rand Paul’s first U.S. Senate race before moving into general consulting on congressional and statewide campaigns nationwide. Nancy Mace for Governor is bringing together the best minds in the **America First** movement. The **MAGA movement** will take us to the finish line to deliver for South Carolinians.****
---

State courts are different and separate from federal courts. While justices on the U.S. Supreme Court are nominated by the President and confirmed by the U.S. Senate, here in PA, state court judges and justices are elected in partisan elections and serve a 10-year term. After their 10-year term, voters will decide to retain them or not through non-partisan retention elections. In a non-partisan retention election, Pennsylvania voters will vote “yes” or “no” for the judges and justices to stay on the bench or not. name: Carolina, United We Dream
subject: We fought for DACA. We’re still fighting for our home.
body:
Together, we’ve defended our community for 13 years, and we’re not stopping now. | | | Peter — On August 15, 2012, the first DACA application was accepted. That milestone was born from years of organizing, hope, and determination by immigrant youth and our allies. From that moment on, we have faced attack after attack from anti-immigrant politicians determined to rip our communities apart. But every single time, we have stood together, and we’re still here. For 13 years, courageous immigrant youth, allies, and everyday neighbors have defended our right to live, work, and dream without fear. From the steps of the U.S. Supreme Court in 2020 to the 5th Circuit Court just last year, our resilience has kept DACA alive against all odds. Now, those same forces are working to dismantle DACA piece by piece. They are cutting off access to education and health care, demanding self-deportation, rolling back tuition protections, and even investigating universities that support immigrant students. Without urgent Congressional action, DACA will be reduced to a shadow of what it once was. DACA recipients contribute $648 billion to the economy and are vital members of our communities. They are doctors, teachers, neighbors, and parents. Over 250,000 U.S. citizen children have a parent protected by DACA. If DACA ends, countless people will lose their jobs, their families, and their futures. We have defended our community for 13 years, and we can do it again, but only if we act now. **Congress must pass the American Dream and Promise Act** to provide permanent protections and stop the mass detentions and deportations.[**Will you donate $10 or whatever you can to help us fight back? clean_body: Together, we’ve defended our community for 13 years, and we’re not stopping now. | | | Peter — On August 15, 2012, the first DACA application was accepted. That milestone was born from years of organizing, hope, and determination by immigrant youth and our allies. From that moment on, we have faced attack after attack from anti-immigrant politicians determined to rip our communities apart. But every single time, we have stood together, and we’re still here. For 13 years, courageous immigrant youth, allies, and everyday neighbors have defended our right to live, work, and dream without fear. From the steps of the U.S. Supreme Court in 2020 to the 5th Circuit Court just last year, our resilience has kept DACA alive against all odds. Now, those same forces are working to dismantle DACA piece by piece. They are cutting off access to education and health care, demanding self-deportation, rolling back tuition protections, and even investigating universities that support immigrant students. Without urgent Congressional action, DACA will be reduced to a shadow of what it once was. DACA recipients contribute $648 billion to the economy and are vital members of our communities. They are doctors, teachers, neighbors, and parents. Over 250,000 U.S. citizen children have a parent protected by DACA. If DACA ends, countless people will lose their jobs, their families, and their futures. We have defended our community for 13 years, and we can do it again, but only if we act now. Congress must pass the American Dream and Promise Act to provide permanent protections and stop the mass detentions and deportations. It’s not democracy if voters don’t get to choose their leaders. |
#

Hi Peter, By now, you may have seen what’s going on in Texas. Republican politicians are drawing voting maps that all but guarantee they stay in power — no matter what voters want. They’ve carved up communities of color, diluted the voting power of young people, and rigged the system. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113315222/563359628/2635701?refcode=AU_GWN_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250814_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTE3YTczNy0yNDc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4_qnY0AzHu1GtLFyNXyBKPqE80TGlDANb3RgdQWFiMo=&emci=b7d50c1b-6678-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=d117a737-2479-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=28008880) And it’s not just happening in Texas. We’ve seen it right here in North Carolina. In 2023, I was drawn out of my 50-50, fair district by Republicans in Raleigh so that I couldn’t run again. Unless we stand up and fight back, it’ll only get worse. Donald Trump knows he’s in trouble for the 2026 midterms - so he’s trying to cheat and get 5 more seats for Republicans before a single vote is cast. This isn’t what democracy is supposed to look like. **The people are supposed to choose their leaders, not the other way around.** I believe in a government that’s accountable to _you_. That starts with fair maps, fair elections, and elected officials who listen to their constituents. Are you with me? Peter,

I believe the best way to stop Donald Trump is to stand together and speak out.

Gerrymandering-- an original American sin with new superpowers -- represents not just an electoral injustice, but a uniquely _geographical_ one.
As a geographer, I know that every line on a map carries meaning. These boundaries decide whether a neighborhood's voice echoes in the halls of power or gets swallowed by the statistical noise of a rigged district.
It's the same science I used in public health to track the spread of a virus, except here the contagion is disenfranchisement, creeping outward through coordinates and census blocks.
When you understand the geography, you see the patterns: minority communities split like puzzle pieces, urban voters siphoned off into sprawling rural districts, natural boundaries ignored in favor of partisan gain.
Maps don't just describe reality--they create it. And they can distort it just as easily. And when the people drawing them are driven by power instead of fairness, the map itself becomes the weapon.

subject: I visited the ICE detention center in Tacoma

body:
With horrific stories coming out of facilities like the so-called “Alligator Alcatraz” in Florida, I want to ensure that the people held here in my district are treated with respect and dignity. We are all human beings.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113319288/563373617/2145945666?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.08.14_Detention_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjYyOTQzZS0yOTc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JSE_YwDaZ3XzmIWrk_4e6EViHbhdzKdfR6g9Al_-Zag=&emci=0d62f14a-6f78-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=2b62943e-2979-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=23483442) | Peter, **Last week, I visited the Northwest Detention Center, where ICE is currently detaining more than 1,500 people.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113319289/563373618/-434166923?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.08.14_Detention_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjYyOTQzZS0yOTc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JSE_YwDaZ3XzmIWrk_4e6EViHbhdzKdfR6g9Al_-Zag=&emci=0d62f14a-6f78-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=2b62943e-2979-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=23483442) With horrific stories coming out of facilities like the so-called “Alligator Alcatraz” in Florida, I want to ensure that the people held here in my district are treated with respect and dignity. _**We are all human beings.**_ Here are some of my observations and concerns from the visit: • The facility has been here in Tacoma for ten years, but the number of detainees has more than doubled, from 700 people held last November to 1,562 now. The facility’s capacity is 1,575. • The facility has a 25% vacancy rate among medical staff, not because of staff departures but because of the rising population. I spoke to two detainees who voiced concerns about medical care. • I learned that detainees are only given four pairs of underwear each week, even though laundry is done once a week. • The week of my visit, there were independent reports of seven detainees suspected of having Tuberculosis. The staff at the facility told me there are no active cases of Tuberculosis, but the reporting and my visit leave me deeply concerned about the health of the detainees. **I firmly believe that detaining hundreds of our neighbors does nothing to make us safer. ** These detainees are people who are being snatched up from their workplaces, from the sidewalk, from their immigration hearings. To then place them in unsanitary and unsafe conditions is cruel and dehumanizing. I will make many more visits to the Northwest Detention Center. In the meantime, we all can keep speaking up and keep pushing for transparency, safety, and dignity for our neighbors. [_**Please watch and share KING 5 coverage of my visit to the Tacoma facility, and make sure everyone you know is aware of what is happening in our community →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113319290/563373619/-434166923?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.08.14_Detention_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYjYyOTQzZS0yOTc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JSE_YwDaZ3XzmIWrk_4e6EViHbhdzKdfR6g9Al_-Zag=&emci=0d62f14a-6f78-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=2b62943e-2979-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=23483442) Thank you so much. Sincerely, — Emily

Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That’s why I’m writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College’s **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/6PPTH1KpWJImznJo1bUY2PsbyWsih2dbdzOpvrkboyPa0zQ7u2SW3reE8J5hHUwipnwHk6pdwNDkn63OYO-qiyl76-VRJV4BFfYxyGJ2hT0Kco7-K-AKOOamSj8jOUN0E_YHkVikAMkDEtVbOSXsh5Lj6poyxtliBT8lI752Kq9PtS-dvmd9gwOMJTu4l3WyzDajOuDfpTn8vOCEJK1B5Zbg0GSPuSO2V98xzA3vvOAPt2zzCFP3HWa9xcmFMTV47dnvrKbkqBd3lQUGJE99S1iqOpmq9_3tvRjcjNPLTusgNejLIQx4zxO6NiOvo_4CVgQC8qn416F87YeZliDgcYDrdjJyknzPBcrGnCVv_oVbNIpOTty1_IbsofVIG1PNIQs6UcPLCMubKmQIkKdSEGqBMoyn63HtR-VAqFxUAw772Fo0XGvDX7B-sw3uML6SZpewKU7_Sd36kqeQb74DkdjsU3jR-_Ju6VuGVu4nclm-WUc_Ix3eWrNVW1MVAZl_TAchjrn7e_0EKSWG4sMqHExyNr5t2h2fb6Ffl9FBdg6jSwcAPiFj1MND6VAfeGqy73kGMYvL9z24YOZ3END6A3FYBvOhj-d-88tTVdTFusAOKFc01kKME3bG2-LlNFg3pBjFAkokDv9EtV_6_LQev4j5x4-9RKU-N3OOyoQIxy43P0NLieY2au06_0CuBlBCIng-s8Rzzg/zUFapVNToCeq0J_uo-rBXMAt4TXp07FK/11).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

Fellow Conservative,

_**“Asshole. Buffoon. Mofo. Wannabe Hitler. Gangster. Vile villain.”**_

Those are just a few words Rep. Jasmine Crockett used to describe President Trump. But let’s be honest: those insults aren’t just about him. They’re about you. About me. About anyone who leans conservative, wears a uniform, or believes in this country’s founding values.

They think we’re backward. They believe we are in the way. And worst of all, they think we’ll take it.

**As a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran, I’ve faced far worse than name-calling. I’ve deployed to over 70 countries. I’ve led warriors into battle. I’ve endured life-threatening missions.** And the most important lesson I’ve learned? Quiet professionalism always wins the day.

_[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8192406d1e6f4db789375318a382e1d6&_e=oaJxjWLVVWCLdpwP7Fyam5XsOcGIlnfj9DyznXz-eSGdCgz01_AbgvJ476MuxGrCGFBCkBHRxir7R5Ov3Uys9al-iFP6iMdh8QVGUL9gOv7Z6B8uOPRg1oi41TJ71Lw4fdmAsebGWSVXs7D_hy9549gYUW-k24j-qS4tQ_5rxcRIxkVvLrRYxRVJwD--svjRMc44S_FkR2ow5jZLZthzypRebdD0en0zqTFqSKV-RBPLTGOEOhEc2Oi9zUo1sFtEduFv9IuLLdpgl-p-wv3YUpH8MCytQz2J6pDcD8z94U4PFdu1fIaNVKMwzUXiUj78XZvUJGYHYhkt3ea9EG9NA6Ldi7P2BYi97PtemIN1jg-JIA3_B1ut6S491jAAOVSBneM9niWni-xF3AdrQZMh7U1cFKb-kkY_uo3TpQp-JU2NmhC67JSlUBpM0osS8_H_6rqRrk5Wh0dxhIelJ0QNu-ZncdXF9ITFiXjplu5r3GOhSTpd10X1vdD_naTqr3DBuHBIqffNFkNKZBNnIywzRyyR4EKkZMQf0-jQCgBO_RNXGnDXdLyw6X2zrUoCCPLuAcZOLE9jt93M2KcAxUsOv_ECEyOxEXSGEAKDwJ6aY48wFq3qrsU2freCmnwZQJ0S4yhelC-vsa-9jW5K2QUOli4NKC2U4ochcKZo8vFPBHUi9GknsUzk573OnCWVMOuo7RvSYHosOSLfID0amd2hbkispcVMwWfsJMMbHYFWYcTbvWeX4UEZpxw92r8gIeEBywl2bTEptXn_0msBZbhqMQ%3D%3D)_
That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — not to yell or mock, but to**fight with discipline, humility, and relentless purpose.**

I didn’t plan on entering politics. But the more I came home from deployment, the more I saw a Minnesota I didn’t recognize. Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor — the person I’m running against — isn’t just radically out of step with our values; she embodies the same hard-left extremism that’s trying to rewrite our entire society.

While Walz called for calm in 2020, she was preparing a lawsuit against the Minneapolis Police. As crime soared and businesses burned, she blamed the people trying to hold the line. These are the people in charge now — and they’re not moderating.

**You can close this email and forget my name. Or you can help send the second Navy SEAL to the U.S. Senate — someone trained for chaos, unafraid of the fight, and grounded in service, not ego. **

**[Will you chip in $1, $5, or even $50 to help me win this battle?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8192406d1e6f4db789375318a382e1d6&_e=oaJxjWLVVWCLdpwP7Fyam5XsOcGIlnfj9DyznXz-eSGdCgz01_AbgvJ476MuxGrCGFBCkBHRxir7R5Ov3Uys9al-iFP6iMdh8QVGUL9gOv7Z6B8uOPRg1oi41TJ71Lw4fdmAsebGWSVXs7D_hy9549gYUW-k24j-qS4tQ_5rxcRIxkVvLrRYxRVJwD--svjRMc44S_FkR2ow5jZLZthzypRebdD0en0zqTFqSKV-RBPLTGOEOhEc2Oi9zUo1sFtEduFv9IuLLdpgl-p-wv3YUpn_KQAgDPv0ddWFsn2DWYsGXs9Cb6IJxSNNDZuumUxxgJOjIo2KkUjJ2LWxF2N6q5BpX3rNdqzPxN5M-mROk6-b-eD1Q_SikrnkMH3lhhcqeUF4l2eYbgJ6CgoyqiSDKiDsmh585dzbia1Fdm0JsdvHOAw6kEf_wdlEaI4rqWjJzUlkRxt79LKxUWsnFY6nUDiziNEX_D5naXYJpBeE9wwiP1yjmRckTBNKwztnG9oITglfsI3RAMLBr3YbN1s8BE-a5QRtQix8vqpLTOqmlEebFch4_4mSmVA6bsGzCudhdJ-8DDcu5-Y0z6NRg9EE9s_k08oy-vgEZErWYmKysPzAtP97uMHK3RaYxhNQ3tpqKJ5zZpNCLmEfQk-HlHDx_4bPJmPk4CQ4uWJvXIwhpU0soVJ1u_H5X6u58z396zcCEIqxJaiLT1e2VnYkzTUBC3c-6rCWKTg11OJjk62FjfOdoz0kTDHiuwvsdGctUphtO5-pti-Gj780dmWq5KJOVw%3D%3D)**

I grew up playing hockey. **I joined the Marine Corps on my 18th birthday in October 2001, less than two months after 9/11.** I served because I love this country, wanted to make my mom proud, and knew I had something to give. Twenty-four years later, I still feel that calling. It’s just a different kind of battlefield.

This won’t be easy. Minnesota hasn’t gone red in a presidential election since 1976. And I know I’m the underdog — just a regular guy from Minnesota who’s been asked to do extraordinary things one more time. With your help, I know we can flip this Senate seat for the Republican Party - but that will require you getting involved TODAY. And you have a choice.

__ I’ve earned advanced degrees from Harvard and Johns Hopkins. I’ve trained in nuclear deterrence. I’ve worked across cultures, built teams under pressure, and led calmly when it mattered most. But none of that compares to the challenge ahead of me now — earning your trust and building a movement powerful enough to flip this seat.

**I’m not asking for a blank check. I’m asking for a chance.**

[**CONTRIBUTE WHAT YOU CAN →**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8192406d1e6f4db789375318a382e1d6&_e=oaJxjWLVVWCLdpwP7Fyam5XsOcGIlnfj9DyznXz-eSGdCgz01_AbgvJ476MuxGrCGFBCkBHRxir7R5Ov3Uys9al-iFP6iMdh8QVGUL9gOv7Z6B8uOPRg1oi41TJ71Lw4fdmAsebGWSVXs7D_hy9549gYUW-k24j-qS4tQ_5rxcRIxkVvLrRYxRVJwD--svjRMc44S_FkR2ow5jZLZthzypRebdD0en0zqTFqSKV-RBPLTGOEOhEc2Oi9zUo1sFtEduFv9IuLLdpgl-p-wv3YUlSp7LC6nT864uz8oR9MM4OV0LrRKZ9nHljjcfCk4n7x1h_u-No1UX8lZ5PFSIqO50XoGJKBFqwWlgDb2C1T8d8W39IPiX7pc26xK_87muFs_d1_YDTWcdzLxF_ofcsr9Sves1ncGiJK2A8905uhhDvo9yYgnUrOsuVFxkMI5whnG6w2ZKIyOgE_AmO05Q0iyvQy3-NaRh-SuZYof3mCeuzBeg2voC3zgsvd3Culdotv0Q0_eYLk8XK3pdfoqwPU6o_2wT3Ezun-3OJTRgbgyrjw1nvEYktSikPZLPEP10X89p7lPeeSXsBkt1A4uoDYjlRI1t7NrEa2BR_VD3YVgjt9BRYfV2aGJ_DoH_oXjxexc4qaWrXc0MJjG2SBxuRLKf4hkLA7uQPnPZltGOD4gsB2hAXN3A5vV2rHPbsq8E9BhQ2oU8Nu-Q3W1blEJeG3xE9rHmjT7WFQM2wvSnqon6Hhm01AEeZIFdmHeg-8vjM4Fb4QhJuchxvHBFRpcGQGWQ%3D%3D)
Because we still live in a country worth defending. Respect and results still matter. And I believe people like you are ready to fight — not with insults, but with action.

clean_body: You don’t have to give anything, but if you believe America is still worth defending, I hope you’ll enlist with me today. | Fellow Conservative, “Asshole. Buffoon. Mofo. Wannabe Hitler. Gangster. Vile villain.” Those are just a few words Rep. Jasmine Crockett used to describe President Trump. But let’s be honest: those insults aren’t just about him. They’re about you. About me. About anyone who leans conservative, wears a uniform, or believes in this country’s founding values. They think we’re backward. They believe we are in the way. And worst of all, they think we’ll take it. As a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran, I’ve faced far worse than name-calling. I’ve deployed to over 70 countries. I’ve led warriors into battle. I’ve endured life-threatening missions. And the most important lesson I’ve learned? Quiet professionalism always wins the day. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — not to yell or mock, but tofight with discipline, humility, and relentless purpose. I didn’t plan on entering politics. But the more I came home from deployment, the more I saw a Minnesota I didn’t recognize. Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor — the person I’m running against — isn’t just radically out of step with our values; she embodies the same hard-left extremism that’s trying to rewrite our entire society. While Walz called for calm in 2020, she was preparing a lawsuit against the Minneapolis Police. As crime soared and businesses burned, she blamed the people trying to hold the line. These are the people in charge now — and they’re not moderating. You can close this email and forget my name. Or you can help send the second Navy SEAL to the U.S. Senate — someone trained for chaos, unafraid of the fight, and grounded in service, not ego. I grew up playing hockey. I joined the Marine Corps on my 18th birthday in October 2001, less than two months after 9/11. I served because I love this country, wanted to make my mom proud, and knew I had something to give. Twenty-four years later, I still feel that calling. It’s just a different kind of battlefield. This won’t be easy. Minnesota hasn’t gone red in a presidential election since 1976. And I know I’m the underdog — just a regular guy from Minnesota who’s been asked to do extraordinary things one more time. With your help, I know we can flip this Senate seat for the Republican Party - but that will require you getting involved TODAY. And you have a choice. I’ve earned advanced degrees from Harvard and Johns Hopkins. I’ve trained in nuclear deterrence. I’ve worked across cultures, built teams under pressure, and led calmly when it mattered most. But none of that compares to the challenge ahead of me now — earning your trust and building a movement powerful enough to flip this seat. I’m not asking for a blank check. I’m asking for a chance. Because we still live in a country worth defending. Respect and results still matter. And I believe people like you are ready to fight — not with insults, but with action. I hope you can take a moment to read, in full, this letter to you. **It’s from the heart and important to me.**

This has been the most draining and emotionally challenging ordeal of my life.

**When I started Project Veritas, my intent was pure and remains so**. I wanted to expose the corruption and hypocrisy in our society and governments.

I wanted to give you a glimpse behind the curtain by presenting raw video footage of what goes on behind closed doors.

And I did it, time and time again. **I'll continue to do so until my last breath.**

But the people I trusted at Project Veritas turned on me. They effectively terminated me, and when that wasn't enough, they sued me to stop me from doing the work that fires my heart.

That lawsuit continues today; it's a massive burden, but it's part of my mission to tell the truth, and **I need your help to keep fighting to bring the darkness to light**. [**Will you donate today to my legal defense fund?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11708475/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLWRldmlsLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA4MTQ/LbmNsNXFQU1pBbg/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctZGV2aWwmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxMjMwX3dyMQ/gaJ4Opg/s5rd33dfe5d)

Our bills continue to grow, and as we near trial, [**I can't do it without your help**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11708475/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLWRldmlsLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA4MTQ/LbmNsNXFQU1pBbg/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctZGV2aWwmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxMjMwX3dyMQ/gaJ4Opg/s5rd33dfe5d).

But we will win, and you will know the truth and be able to see for yourself who was behind the destruction of the organization I poured my heart and soul into.

[**Your support means I can keep fighting to expose the truth**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11708475/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLWRldmlsLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA4MTQ/LbmNsNXFQU1pBbg/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctZGV2aWwmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxMjMwX3dyMQ/gaJ4Opg/s5rd33dfe5d) that's locked behind closed doors.

Almost a year ago today, I filed a counterclaim against Project Veritas. That gave me the ability to pursue justice rather than sit on the defense.

The ongoing case is all about that. It's not only about justice, but also about gathering facts through discovery, depositions, and our eventual trial.

While I can't share those facts right now, [**with your help, the truth will come out**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11708475/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLWRldmlsLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA4MTQ/LbmNsNXFQU1pBbg/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctZGV2aWwmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxMjMwX3dyMQ/gaJ4Opg/s5rd33dfe5d).

My parents taught me to see the world in binary colors, black and white, good and bad. Over my years of work, **I've come to realize that the more good that you do, the more the devil will try to stop you.**

From this lawsuit to countless others, from being locked up as a young man on false charges, to having the FBI raid my home in the early morning hours**, the devil has tried to break my spirit, kill my will, and discourage me from doing the good that's a result of my passion.**

And during all of those trials, **people like you have stood by me**. Good people who choose to stand by me and smile in the face of evil and say, "**not today, satan . . . not today**."

[**Your support not only helps me keep going**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11708475/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLWRldmlsLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA4MTQ/LbmNsNXFQU1pBbg/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctZGV2aWwmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxMjMwX3dyMQ/gaJ4Opg/s5rd33dfe5d), but it gives me hope that **darkness will never overtake the light as long as there are people like us still breathing.**

So thank you. Sincerely, thank you.

[**Please donate today and help me keep this fight going, sending a message that good still exists in this world**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e11708475/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLWRldmlsLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA4MTQ/LbmNsNXFQU1pBbg/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctZGV2aWwmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1vbSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bWImYW1vdW50PTI1JnV0bV90ZXJtPTIxMjMwX3dyMQ/gaJ4Opg/s5rd33dfe5d).

Thank you for all that you do.

In truth,
James O’Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

Here's what you need to know and what you can do to help save the Postal Service.

1\. **The Post Office is enshrined in the US Constitution and created by an act of Congress.** _Trump’s efforts to unilaterally dismantle it are unconstitutional!_

clean_body: Democrats have let our nation’s capital fall too far| | | Friend, Our nation’s capital should be a beacon to the world of everything America represents. Yet Washington D.C. has become one of our nation’s most dangerous cities. Bold leadership is the only solution for rampant crime. If the Mayors and Police Chiefs of Washington won’t tackle crime head on, thank GOD we have a President who will! I am proud to stand with President Trump on his DC Crime Crackdown! Whatever resources the President, Attorney General, and National Guard need to bring order back to Washington they should have. This should not be a partisan issue. EVERYONE should want safer communities. Why are Democrats rallying against public safety? Democrats cannot be trusted to keep this country safe– The United States’ capital needs to be a city on a hill that represents the best America has to offer and should never be mentioned in the same sentence as Baghdad and Kabul as one of the world’s most dangerous places. | Donald Trump is breaking his promise to hardworking Americans.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=4924%2E35263%2E7TJ2zT)
Peter, today marks the 90th anniversary of the _Social Security Act_ , which was signed into law by President Franklin Delano Roosevelt as part of the New Deal. This landmark legislation represents a promise to generations of hardworking Americans; that everyone deserves to retire in dignity. On the campaign trail, Donald Trump promised in state after state, interview after interview, that he wouldn’t touch Social Security. **Yet now that his Big, Ugly Bill has passed, the benefits that people work their entire lives for will be slashed.** I’m working with Senate Democrats to fight back against these cuts to Social Security. 1.3 million Wisconsinites receive Social Security benefits, and I’m not going to let right-wing leaders take these benefits away. Union officials I bet you've never even heard of -- like Everett Kelly.

Now, he's collecting a full pension "close to equal to my salary."

The agency reportedly was "_RIFE WITH CORRUPTION" whose staffers "LIVED LIKE KINGS_." Despite having only 60 employees (many of whose offices had ENSUITE BATHROOMS WITH PRIVATE SHOWERS!), the FMCS occupied a _nine-story office tower_ on DC's posh K Street.
According to the Daily Wire, for years the agency's Director _billed the taxpayer for his meals and living expenses, claiming to be on a "years-long business trip" to DC_.

_ALL SO PRIVILEGED UNION BULLIES CAN PAD THEIR WALLETS WITH OUR HARD-EARNED DOLLARS AND PAY OFF THEIR FAR-LEFT POLITICAL PALS_!

FOR LIBERTY,

U.S. Senator Rand Paul

**\---------- Forwarded message from Dr. Raul Ruiz ----------**
It’s Raul.
I’ve been keeping a close eye on what’s happening with redistricting in Republican-led states — and it’s honestly pretty alarming.
Simply put, Republicans across the country are trying to game the system.
They’re working to redraw congressional maps in a way that could give them more seats, even in places where voters clearly aren’t with them.
It’s all part of their plan to tilt the scales before voters even have a say.
California has had one of the fairest redistricting systems in the country, and we’re proud of that. But if states like Texas, Florida, and others keep aggressively pushing their already gerrymandered maps even further to the right, California may have to respond.
That uncertainty means we have to be ready for whatever comes next.
CA-25 could shift. It could very likely become more competitive. And we need to be prepared, and not caught off guard.
But right now, we’re heading into the toughest stretch of the year: the summer fundraising slump. Donations have started to slow down, just when we need to be building strength for whatever Republicans throw at us next.
That’s why my team set a mid-month fundraising goal of $5,000 before Friday at midnight — to make sure we’re ready, no matter what the new maps could look like.

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. body:
We must educate and advocate for policies that enhance Social Security's longevity and effectiveness.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113323911/563388954/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDRmYzllMy0zMjc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=19bdA7JFA3yYHcOsCX2uMZzmlBzZPbUvoLiefRDbAe4=&emci=e45444fe-5e71-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&emdi=1d4fc9e3-3279-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=9494239)
---

| | Today marks the 90th Anniversary of the creation of Social Security. On this day in 1935, the monumental 37-page Social Security Act was signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt. And now, most Americans do not remember a time before Social Security. In the years since its adoption, the landmark legislation has evolved into a euphemism for retirement benefits. But it is more than just a monthly check for retirees - **it is a safety net for**** _everyone_****that provides financial stability and peace of mind throughout life.** Social Security includes: **Retirement Security:** The most common connotation of Social Security is the safeguards for the retired. It ensures that your hard work is rewarded with a reliable income stream in our golden years. It is a promise of dignity and independence after a lifetime of work and contributions to your community's economy. **Disability Protection:** Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. **Survivor Benefits:** Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. **Whether you are nearing retirement or just starting your career, understanding and supporting Social Security is vital.** But Social Security and its beneficiaries are vulnerable right now. The Big Ugly Bill has made catastrophic cuts to important programs like Social Security. I am furious about the devastating cuts Republicans have rushed through this year with the Big Ugly Bill. **To me, it is plain and simple: hardworking folks paid into Social Security, and it is not a handout.** I oppose the privatization of Social Security and have sponsored "Scrap the Cap" legislation, which would no longer exempt income earned above $147,000 from Social Security taxes to strengthen the Social Security fund. **Social Security demonstrates our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for**** _everyone_****, regardless of their socioeconomic status.** And as a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security, I am redoubling my efforts to fortify these protections. But it is more than just a monthly check for retirees - it is a safety net for everyonethat provides financial stability and peace of mind throughout life. Social Security includes: Retirement Security: The most common connotation of Social Security is the safeguards for the retired. It ensures that your hard work is rewarded with a reliable income stream in our golden years. It is a promise of dignity and independence after a lifetime of work and contributions to your community's economy. Disability Protection: Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. Survivor Benefits: Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. https://www.movement4freedom.com/home [https://www.movement4freedom.com/home]
Hey Peter,
The house is on fire. The Senate is in shambles. Trump and his extremist allies are doing everything in their power to annihilate what little progress we’ve made.
Rolling back civil rights. Silencing dissent. Gutting social programs. Funding police while cutting our healthcare.
As for us? We refuse to stand by. We organize. We build. We fight back. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/a2pVR-j6WkStxflHIVcSQw2]
Like Chris Smalls, the labor organizer who led the historic Amazon union drive, who was reportedly beaten and arrested by Israeli forces while delivering humanitarian aid to Gaza as part of the Freedom Flotilla.
Like the dozens of activists on those boats, who risked everything to bring food, medicine, and solidarity to people under siege.
That’s what real solidarity looks like. And that’s what our series Action August is about: spotlighting the leaders, the organizers, politivists, cultural workers, and freedom fighters who are putting it all on the line for others.
This month, Movement for Freedom is uplifting the politivists and activists who are out here getting it done . Folks who are challenging power, building community, and refusing to give in. And we need your input.
Who else is putting it all on the line? Who’s organizing mutual aid, challenging power, feeding their neighbors, fighting fascism, or building joy in the face of oppression? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/a2pVR-j6WkStxflHIVcSQw2]
Tell us who they are, nominate someone for us to highlight for Action August today:
NOMINATE SOMEONE TO HIGHLIGHT [https://secure.ngpvan.com/a2pVR-j6WkStxflHIVcSQw2]
Movement for Freedom is about empowering everyday people to create change. In our streets, in our schools, in City Hall, in Congress. This is a moment for bold action, not caution. It’s time to celebrate the ones who are making moves, and remind each other what real leadership looks like.
Thank you and onward,
— Stephany
Lead Spokesperson, Movement for Freedom

Domestic workers are some of the most vulnerable to police overreach and militarized immigration enforcement raids.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/113325062/563392358/664783965?utm_campaign=cia_pp&utm_medium=email&utm_source=cs&ms=c4_dc_takeover&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjUxMzg2NS0zNjc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vQbFpgKATYCdeezJG-h_y7hHSwX9lRVHMuFA8aUR4MU=&emci=55487588-9378-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=32513865-3679-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=864787)
Trump deploying the National Guard and FBI in Washington, D.C., and taking control of the local police, is an **unambiguous attempt to project authoritarian power** against the people of D.C. and communities across the country.
Since Monday, residents of D.C. have been under **constant threat of random, unpredictable stops by federal law enforcement** on street corners, at intersections, and on public transit. This abuse of power does nothing to keep communities, workers, and families safe — in fact, it makes everyone less safe.
**Domestic workers, who are mostly Black, Latina, Asian American, and immigrants, are already some of the most vulnerable to police overreach and militarized immigration enforcement raids**. Now, domestic workers are at even greater risk in D.C. It’s critical that we speak out and let the Trump administration know that we stand together in solidarity against his military deployment.
[**Can you add your name today to let the Trump administration know that his military occupation of Washington D.C. won’t go unchallenged?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/113325063/563392360/-142017540?utm_campaign=cia_pp&utm_medium=email&utm_source=cs&ms=c4_dc_takeover&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjUxMzg2NS0zNjc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vQbFpgKATYCdeezJG-h_y7hHSwX9lRVHMuFA8aUR4MU=&emci=55487588-9378-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=32513865-3679-f011-b481-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=864787)

Trump said that he’s using D.C. as a testing ground for these military tactics in other big cities like Chicago, New York City and Oakland. The White House has already sent the military into one other big city: Los Angeles. After violent ICE raids sparked mass protests in LA, Trump sent in the National Guard and Marines.
As Trump uses the U.S. military against the American people, he is exerting his dangerous agenda on all of us. **He’s targeting vulnerable communities as an obvious attempt to distract attention from the fact that his cuts to Medicaid are overwhelmingly unpopular.**
**We know domestic workers and working class communities will feel the worst of this**. We can’t let Trump think he can impose domination on the people of D.C. without facing enormous nationwide pushback. We will stand strong together, we won’t stay silent, and we will protect our neighbors.

clean_body: Domestic workers are some of the most vulnerable to police overreach and militarized immigration enforcement raids. Trump deploying the National Guard and FBI in Washington, D.C., and taking control of the local police, is an unambiguous attempt to project authoritarian power against the people of D.C. and communities across the country. Since Monday, residents of D.C. have been under constant threat of random, unpredictable stops by federal law enforcement on street corners, at intersections, and on public transit. This abuse of power does nothing to keep communities, workers, and families safe — in fact, it makes everyone less safe. Domestic workers, who are mostly Black, Latina, Asian American, and immigrants, are already some of the most vulnerable to police overreach and militarized immigration enforcement raids. Now, domestic workers are at even greater risk in D.C. It’s critical that we speak out and let the Trump administration know that we stand together in solidarity against his military deployment. Trump said that he’s using D.C. as a testing ground for these military tactics in other big cities like Chicago, New York City and Oakland. The White House has already sent the military into one other big city: Los Angeles. After violent ICE raids sparked mass protests in LA, Trump sent in the National Guard and Marines. As Trump uses the U.S. military against the American people, he is exerting his dangerous agenda on all of us. He’s targeting vulnerable communities as an obvious attempt to distract attention from the fact that his cuts to Medicaid are overwhelmingly unpopular. We know domestic workers and working class communities will feel the worst of this. We can’t let Trump think he can impose domination on the people of D.C. without facing enormous nationwide pushback. We will stand strong together, we won’t stay silent, and we will protect our neighbors. This is about all of us: the domestic workers, and communities of Los Angeles, D.C., and the next city Trump could try this in. Thank you, The Care in Action Team

name: Voter Action Project
subject: This is about every state
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team -- Opponents of voting rights have made a strong bet. They've doubled down on it the last few years, too.
Their bet was that we'd only care about certain states. That as long as we were focused on the swing states like Arizona, Georgia, Pennsylvania, and others, they would be free to suppress votes in states like Utah, South Dakota, Mississippi, or Kentucky. And you know what? That bet has paid off for them.
When Wisconsin tried to ban drop boxes, there was an immediate reaction and lawsuits. But not when South Dakota did the same. When Texas started messing with changes to voter ID requirements, people howled. But when Utah functionally suppressed the youth vote with new ID requirements, they got away with it.
They've created a feedback loop: States with restrictive voting laws receive little attention because they aren't electorally competitive. But part of the reason they aren’t competitive is because their state laws prevent large segments of the population from voting .
Team, we cannot afford to skip any state when it comes to protecting our fundamental right to vote. Step up and give $25 or whatever you can today and help us make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081425_1&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=081425_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=081425_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=081425_1&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=081425_1&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=081425_1&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=081425_1&amount=35]
We've highlighted things in these things in the past , like voter ID in Utah or court decisions in Kansas or the most suppressive state-level voting law in Indiana, but we have to fight harder there.
The danger in ignoring the voting rights of citizens in more than half the country is that it creates a two-tiered democracy . Voters in the swing states benefit from attention and legal actions, while voters everywhere else are left to navigate increasingly onerous and burdensome requirements without meaningful support or scrutiny.
We have to fight everywhere. Donald Trump is actively dismantling democratic institutions and undermining the rule of law . Only through free and fair elections can we hope to restore our republic. But that requires free and fair elections in every state, not just in a strategic few.
Fuel our efforts to fight for voting rights everywhere with $25 or more and make every vote count >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=081425_1&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=081425_1&amount=20]

He's tried to pull us out of NATO. Now, if these reports are true, he's preparing to sell out American interests and global democracy for a payday. _**This is bigger than foreign policy -- it's about whether the leader of the United States can be bought by an adversary. If Trump takes the deal, it will embolden dictators everywhere and put every democracy on the chopping block.**_ And here's the thing: this is exactly why we're fighting to win in every corner of the country. clean_body: Ever wonder what real leadership looks like...? Well, this is it: Gov. Andy Beshear just brought $110 million back to Kentucky for our schools, Peter. This funding will help districts all across the Commonwealth make long-overdue upgrades to school buildings, improve safety, and create environments where our kids can focus on learning and growing. At In This Together PAC, we have always believed that every child deserves to feel safe and supported when they walk into their school, and Andy’s working around the clock to make that a reality for kids all across Kentucky. Andy knows a quality education is the start of a bright future. That's why his leadership is focused on everyone, not just the people who voted for him, and not just the people with the most resources — but every single person across Kentucky, even our children, because all of us deserve a fair shot. This is the kind of leadership we need to protect and expand on in our state and all across the country. Americans from every walk of life deserve leadership that delivers for working families, invests in our kids, and makes decisions with the people’s best interests at heart — not for special interests and not to serve themselves. We’re proud to stand with Andy, and we need to know you’re with him too. Fellow Democrat-
At 10:00 a.m. on Monday, Donald Trump announced an unprecedented and dangerous move: he is federalizing the DC Police and deploying the National Guard, against the will of elected leaders and the people of Washington, D.C.
Trump claims this is about crime. We know it’s not.
According to the U.S. Department of Justice, violent crime in DC is at a 30-year low . This isn’t about safety, it’s about control. This is a staged political stunt designed to seize power in the nation’s capital and send a chilling message to other cities across the country.
Trump says he is “liberating” DC, but make no mistake, he is the biggest threat to our freedom. If we don’t stop him here, he will use this same playbook to undermine democracy in cities and states everywhere, including right here at home in Massachusetts.
The DC Democratic Party is mobilizing to fight back through legal action, organizing, and national advocacy. But this fight will be long and expensive, and we need every Democrat who believes in self-governance to step up right now.
If you make a contribution [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dcdemsxmassdems] today, it will go directly toward defending DC’s rights, pushing back against Trump’s authoritarian power grab, and ensuring that the voices of 700,000 DC residents are heard loud and clear.
Rush a Donation to Defend DC's Rights! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dcdemsxmassdems]
This is exactly the fight for democracy we’ve been warning about for years. If we all act together, we can stop this blatant attack on our freedoms and show Trump and his power-hungry gang of cronies that we will never surrender our rights.
In solidarity,

A recent poll showed that over half of Generation Z is likely to vote for candidates with socialist positions. We have seen some of this in recent elections.

Recently, voters in America's largest city nominated a self-avowed socialist to be mayor. Some of his proposals include...
* Banning ICE agents from city limits

* Establishing city-owned grocery stores

* Instituting a $30-an-hour minimum wage

* Replacing the police with social workers

**In short, this candidate will bring _real, unapologetic socialism_ to America.**

**Why did this happen? **

For one thing, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried.

For another, too many are no longer being taught about America's great heritage of liberty and the importance of the Constitution to freedom.

This is because of the "progressive" Left's increasing success in hijacking American education at both the K-12 and college levels. **So, it 's no surprise that those who support socialist candidates tend to be college-educated!**

In the face of these efforts to indoctrinate the young and undermine informed patriotism, **Hillsdale 's educational outreach is needed now more than ever.**

By responding to **Hillsdale College 's National Survey on Socialism**, your honest opinions will help us understand the rise of socialism and form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country--Americans like you, who still revere our founding principles of liberty, as set forth in the Declaration of Independence, and which form the foundation of our Constitution.

The Social Security Act was signed 90 years ago today. Now Donald Trump is threatening its future.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=3796%2E400544%2E6ktWdR)
Team,
90 years ago today, our country made a promise: that after a lifetime of hard work, people deserve to retire with dignity and stability.
**_90 years later, that promise is under attack.**_
**Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans have made it clear they want to dismantle Social Security** , with Trump’s Treasury Secretary openly talking about “backdoors to privatize” the long-standing safety net program.
In Trump’s eyes, our most vulnerable are expendable. But to us? They’re our family, friends, caretakers, and neighbors.
Here in New Mexico, Social Security is a critical lifeline. **More than 460,000 New Mexicans** receive monthly benefits and rely on it to afford food, housing, and other essential needs. Deb has always fought to protect it — first in Congress and now as a candidate for Governor.
But she needs your help if she’s going to win. Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans are trying to flip our state red and we can’t afford to let that happen.
**[Can you chip in $5 today to help Deb keep up the fight for _all_ New Mexicans and build a brighter future for our state?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250814_2_socialsecurity?amount=5&refcode=em20250814-3796&refcode2=3796_400544_6ktWdR&akid=3796%2E400544%2E6ktWdR)**

_Today 's a two-for-one day! _
_Sorry to blast your inbox, but both stories published today are critical, urgent news!_
_This article is being provided without a paywall. If you have any questions, please send me a message! And, as always, please support my work by upgrading to a paid subscription today!_
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..FlHAUNens3xVEVXZbeKCK9iW8hT79uAKwRE-SKKCYCA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=170994979)
* * *
The [State of the Climate report](https://substack.com/redirect/57e351c9-417f-44ea-87e4-e97d60ba0cc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) released earlier today, delivers a stunning verdict: greenhouse gases--CO2, methane, and the like--climbed to unprecedented heights, painting a picture of a world ever more trapped in its fever.
Carbon dioxide alone tipped the scales at around **422.8 ppm** , a weight 52% heavier than pre-industrial skies. The growth rate today creeps ahead at more than **2.4 ppm per year** , compared to a meager 0.6 ppm in the 1960s.
Temperatures followed suit: land and ocean joined hands in setting a new global high for surface warmth. Ocean heat, too, lurched upward, the oceans absorbing energy like a cauldron under a flame. It's striking--every year now rivals the last, and each previous record seems to fall under the shadow of a new one.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eeecba26-3bd7-4631-8383-ec49c625f558?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Such numbers don't exist in a spreadsheet--they're the shriek of a planet under duress. They signal not only scientific data, but a moral reckoning. Earth isn't just warming--it's lashing back, signaling that the delicate equilibrium that sustained civilizations for centuries is being unstitched, thread by thread.
_[Read the full technical report here.](https://substack.com/redirect/57e351c9-417f-44ea-87e4-e97d60ba0cc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
It is hard not to feel as though the world has gasped--and the gasp has turned into a slow-motion eclipse. The numbers don't lie: for a moment, in 2024, we surpassed that sacred 1.5 °C threshold--albeit briefly. But what haunts is not just the data--it's how the Earth responded: boiling oceans, ghost reefs, melting ice, displaced millions.
Think of the coral reefs--once vibrant underwater cities--now specters, bleached to ghosts by heat. Imagine glaciers calving so relentlessly that the sea rises at rates we haven't seen in modern memory. Picture skies swollen with moisture turning into walls of rain. This isn't climate change--it's a climate upheaval.
Yet every paragraph of the report, every coral bleaching statistic, every carbon-sink decline, every polar warming figure--they beckon a question: can we, as a global species, still alter course? Because make no mistake--this runaway train has brakes. It's just that we have yet to reach out and pull them.
* * *
## Oceans: A Pot Set on the Boil
To imagine what the oceans are enduring is to picture the world's deepest blue slowly simmering--now at record levels of warmth, not just at the surface, but thousands of feet deep.
The oceans, our primary heat buffer, are straining under the relentless accumulation of energy.
What that means for life underwater is chilling. Marine heatwaves roared across 91% of the surface in 2023, and likely lingered into 2024. Coral reefs, those underwater rainforests, couldn't withstand the heat.
Over 84% of them were exposed to bleaching-level temperatures last year, drifting toward ghost reefs, silent and colorless.
This isn't a quiet change--it's a rolling catastrophe unfolding across waves and currents. Heat seeps into the oceans, altering chemistry, collapsing ecosystems, and threatening the vast biodiversity that anchors coastal communities and fisheries alike.
* * *
## Cryosphere & Sea Ice: The Poles Melt, and So Does Our Hope
Glaciers and ice sheets are disappearing faster than ever, their retreat fueling historic sea-level rise. Sea level is climbing at about 4.7 mm per year--more than double the rate of the 1990s. In 2024, record melting, accompanied by staggering ice loss, pushed the average sea level to a new high.
* * *
## Water Cycle & Atmospheric Moisture: A Sky Heavy with Threat
In 2024, the sky wasn't just heat--it was a pressurized vapor chamber. Near-surface **specific humidity** --the actual moisture content in the air--reached record highs across both land and ocean. **Total column water vapor** , the full atmospheric moisture overhead, set unprecedented records too: almost **90 percent of the atmosphere was wetter than the 1991-2020 average**.
Humid heat days--when sweat can't save you--skyrocketed. The planet logged **35.6 days more than normal** where wet-bulb temperatures soared past levels that most bodies cannot bear. That shattered the previous record by **9.5 days** , and delivered a threat far beyond mere numbers.
These aren't statistics--they're unbreathable days, flooded streets, spoiled seasons. The atmosphere is swallowing moisture like it has a debt to pay, and the result is humanity risked being drowned--not just by water--but by the weight of insulated air.
* * *
## Extreme Events & Human Toll: The Earth Throws Fits--and We Get Hit
If you wanted proof that a feverish planet swings harder, 2024 obliged-again and again. The hydrological drumbeat was deafening: globally, it was the **third-wettest year since 1983** , and the planet set a new record for **extreme daily rainfall over land**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e5aa3bf-cf8c-4ef3-8111-5d2485b0473e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dubai supplied the postcard of our new era, taking **250 mm (9.8 in.) in 24 hours** --nearly **three times** its annual average--on streets built for sun, not torrents.
Oceans ran hot for months, priming the atmosphere; the world logged a **record 100 marine heatwave days** on average and a record-low **nine** marine cold-spell days--an upside-down ocean telegraphing trouble to every coastline.
The warmth at the surface didn't stay offshore: daily global sea-surface temperatures were at record highs **from January through late June** , a thermal runway for floods, landslides, and storm-burst deluges that rearranged riverbeds and lives. [American Meteorological Society](https://substack.com/redirect/243f2c28-3328-42f5-83ad-68c950287e25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The year's cyclone count came in a hair **below average** --**82 named storms** versus a 1991-2020 mean of 87--but totals hide the sting.
Impact was the metric that mattered.
In the United States, **Hurricane Helene** tore a water-scar across the Southeast, with **record flooding** through the southern Appalachians and **more than 200 deaths** , the deadliest U.S. hurricane toll since **Katrina (2005)**.
Less than two weeks later, **Hurricane Milton** slammed Florida's Gulf Coast--**the shortest interval on record between major (Cat 3+) Florida landfalls** --a one-two punch that left response systems gasping.
Across the Pacific, **Super Typhoon Yagi** became one of the most destructive storms to strike **China and Vietnam in recent years** , with **800+ fatalities**.
The tally of "named storms" matters far less than the geometry of risk: wetter atmospheres, hotter seas, and more saturated soils amplifying the odds that when a storm does arrive, it arrives mean.
Zoom out and the ledger of loss grows starker. In the United States, **27 separate billion-dollar disasters** in 2024--**second-most on record** --ran the gamut: **17 severe-storm outbreaks** , **five flooding events** , and more, a drumroll of insurance claims and uninsurable grief.
Globally, weather disasters pushed **new displacements to the highest level since systematic records began in 2008** , a human tide moving not by choice but by rainfall totals and tide gauges. These numbers are not abstractions; they're the arithmetic of a world where background conditions have shifted.
* * *
## Atmospheric CO2 & Carbon Cycle: The Air Is Thicker--and Lament Louder
Every ton of carbon we've released still waits in the air--coating our atmosphere thicker and darker.
By 2024, carbon dioxide had reached **422.8 ppm**, methane and nitrous oxide were at their own record highs. CO2 alone is more than **52 percent** above pre-industrial levels.
That's cumulative.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/df13d4c5-3ea2-4568-a673-787e7e8611ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That's legacy air that radiates back to Earth. Meanwhile, natural carbon sinks--forests, soil, ocean--are failing. Drought and fires, especially under recent El Niño conditions, weakened tropical forests' ability to absorb CO2. We've broken the air's resilience, and now our output exceeds the planet's capacity to counteract.
In the simplest terms: we've become the thicker air.
* * *
## Arctic & Antarctic: Amplified Warnings at Earth's Extremes
The poles are warming far faster than the planet as a whole. The Arctic is heating three to four times faster, with some areas like the Barents Sea warming as much as seven times the global average. This amplification shreds ice and changes everything--from weather patterns across continents to shipping lanes and the fragile way of life for Arctic communities.

I provide most of this content for free, but if you can support this work, please upgrade to a paid subscription. Aug 14 | | | | | | | | | | | Today 's a two-for-one day! Sorry to blast your inbox, but both stories published today are critical, urgent news! This article is being provided without a paywall. If you have any questions, please send me a message! And, as always, please support my work by upgrading to a paid subscription today! The released earlier today, delivers a stunning verdict: greenhouse gases--CO2, methane, and the like--climbed to unprecedented heights, painting a picture of a world ever more trapped in its fever. Carbon dioxide alone tipped the scales at around 422.8 ppm , a weight 52% heavier than pre-industrial skies. The growth rate today creeps ahead at more than 2.4 ppm per year , compared to a meager 0.6 ppm in the 1960s. Temperatures followed suit: land and ocean joined hands in setting a new global high for surface warmth. Ocean heat, too, lurched upward, the oceans absorbing energy like a cauldron under a flame. It's striking--every year now rivals the last, and each previous record seems to fall under the shadow of a new one. | | ---|---|--- Such numbers don't exist in a spreadsheet--they're the shriek of a planet under duress. They signal not only scientific data, but a moral reckoning. Earth isn't just warming--it's lashing back, signaling that the delicate equilibrium that sustained civilizations for centuries is being unstitched, thread by thread. It is hard not to feel as though the world has gasped--and the gasp has turned into a slow-motion eclipse. The numbers don't lie: for a moment, in 2024, we surpassed that sacred 1.5 °C threshold--albeit briefly. But what haunts is not just the data--it's how the Earth responded: boiling oceans, ghost reefs, melting ice, displaced millions. Think of the coral reefs--once vibrant underwater cities--now specters, bleached to ghosts by heat. Imagine glaciers calving so relentlessly that the sea rises at rates we haven't seen in modern memory. Picture skies swollen with moisture turning into walls of rain. This isn't climate change--it's a climate upheaval. Yet every paragraph of the report, every coral bleaching statistic, every carbon-sink decline, every polar warming figure--they beckon a question: can we, as a global species, still alter course? Because make no mistake--this runaway train has brakes. It's just that we have yet to reach out and pull them. Oceans: A Pot Set on the Boil To imagine what the oceans are enduring is to picture the world's deepest blue slowly simmering--now at record levels of warmth, not just at the surface, but thousands of feet deep. The oceans, our primary heat buffer, are straining under the relentless accumulation of energy. What that means for life underwater is chilling. Marine heatwaves roared across 91% of the surface in 2023, and likely lingered into 2024. Coral reefs, those underwater rainforests, couldn't withstand the heat. Over 84% of them were exposed to bleaching-level temperatures last year, drifting toward ghost reefs, silent and colorless. This isn't a quiet change--it's a rolling catastrophe unfolding across waves and currents. Heat seeps into the oceans, altering chemistry, collapsing ecosystems, and threatening the vast biodiversity that anchors coastal communities and fisheries alike. Cryosphere & Sea Ice: The Poles Melt, and So Does Our Hope Glaciers and ice sheets are disappearing faster than ever, their retreat fueling historic sea-level rise. Sea level is climbing at about 4.7 mm per year--more than double the rate of the 1990s. In 2024, record melting, accompanied by staggering ice loss, pushed the average sea level to a new high. Water Cycle & Atmospheric Moisture: A Sky Heavy with Threat In 2024, the sky wasn't just heat--it was a pressurized vapor chamber. Near-surface specific humidity --the actual moisture content in the air--reached record highs across both land and ocean. Total column water vapor , the full atmospheric moisture overhead, set unprecedented records too: almost 90 percent of the atmosphere was wetter than the 1991-2020 average. Humid heat days--when sweat can't save you--skyrocketed. The planet logged 35.6 days more than normal where wet-bulb temperatures soared past levels that most bodies cannot bear. That shattered the previous record by 9.5 days , and delivered a threat far beyond mere numbers. These aren't statistics--they're unbreathable days, flooded streets, spoiled seasons. The atmosphere is swallowing moisture like it has a debt to pay, and the result is humanity risked being drowned--not just by water--but by the weight of insulated air. Extreme Events & Human Toll: The Earth Throws Fits--and We Get Hit If you wanted proof that a feverish planet swings harder, 2024 obliged-again and again. The hydrological drumbeat was deafening: globally, it was the third-wettest year since 1983 , and the planet set a new record for extreme daily rainfall over land. | | ---|---|--- Dubai supplied the postcard of our new era, taking 250 mm (9.8 in.) in 24 hours --nearly three times its annual average--on streets built for sun, not torrents. Oceans ran hot for months, priming the atmosphere; the world logged a record 100 marine heatwave days on average and a record-low nine marine cold-spell days--an upside-down ocean telegraphing trouble to every coastline. The warmth at the surface didn't stay offshore: daily global sea-surface temperatures were at record highs from January through late June , a thermal runway for floods, landslides, and storm-burst deluges that rearranged riverbeds and lives. The year's cyclone count came in a hair below average --82 named storms versus a 1991-2020 mean of 87--but totals hide the sting. Impact was the metric that mattered. In the United States, Hurricane Helene tore a water-scar across the Southeast, with record flooding through the southern Appalachians and more than 200 deaths , the deadliest U.S. hurricane toll since Katrina (2005). Less than two weeks later, Hurricane Milton slammed Florida's Gulf Coast--the shortest interval on record between major (Cat 3+) Florida landfalls --a one-two punch that left response systems gasping. Across the Pacific, Super Typhoon Yagi became one of the most destructive storms to strike China and Vietnam in recent years , with 800+ fatalities. The tally of "named storms" matters far less than the geometry of risk: wetter atmospheres, hotter seas, and more saturated soils amplifying the odds that when a storm does arrive, it arrives mean. Zoom out and the ledger of loss grows starker. In the United States, 27 separate billion-dollar disasters in 2024--second-most on record --ran the gamut: 17 severe-storm outbreaks , five flooding events , and more, a drumroll of insurance claims and uninsurable grief. Globally, weather disasters pushed new displacements to the highest level since systematic records began in 2008 , a human tide moving not by choice but by rainfall totals and tide gauges. These numbers are not abstractions; they're the arithmetic of a world where background conditions have shifted. Atmospheric CO2 & Carbon Cycle: The Air Is Thicker--and Lament Louder Every ton of carbon we've released still waits in the air--coating our atmosphere thicker and darker. By 2024, carbon dioxide had reached 422.8 ppm, methane and nitrous oxide were at their own record highs. CO2 alone is more than 52 percent above pre-industrial levels. That's cumulative. | | ---|---|--- That's legacy air that radiates back to Earth. Meanwhile, natural carbon sinks--forests, soil, ocean--are failing. Drought and fires, especially under recent El Niño conditions, weakened tropical forests' ability to absorb CO2. We've broken the air's resilience, and now our output exceeds the planet's capacity to counteract. In the simplest terms: we've become the thicker air. Arctic & Antarctic: Amplified Warnings at Earth's Extremes The poles are warming far faster than the planet as a whole. The Arctic is heating three to four times faster, with some areas like the Barents Sea warming as much as seven times the global average. This amplification shreds ice and changes everything--from weather patterns across continents to shipping lanes and the fragile way of life for Arctic communities.
