name: David Hogg
subject: Donald Trump has no idea how to be president
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
This is why we need the next generation in office... now.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250814-1&t=1&akid=2520%2E587540%2E1XGUD-)
**It’s harder to be a Democrat than a Republican, Peter.**
_Why?_
Because it’s always more difficult to make government work than it is to tear it apart.
Republicans know that. In fact, they count on it.
They’ve spent decades breaking our institutions so people lose faith in them — and then they turn around and say **_“See? Government doesn’t work.”_**
Donald Trump doesn’t even pretend to try.
He governs like a wannabe dictator because he has no idea how to be a president. He pushes half-baked executive orders that get struck down in court, bypasses Congress, and leans on his handpicked Supreme Court to rubber-stamp his worst ideas.
Democrats? We actually want government to work for the people.
That means we have to do the hard, messy, complicated work of governing. Passing laws. Building coalitions. Getting results that last.
And here’s the problem — right now, we don’t have nearly enough leaders with the skill, experience, and grit to do that work for the long haul. That’s why we have to start young.
Just like Joe Biden started young. Just like FDR, LBJ, and the most effective leaders in our history started young. If we want another generation of prolific leaders who can defeat the far-right, we have to elect them now so they can build that experience.
**But running for office has never been more expensive** — and the young, progressive leaders we need don’t have the corporate donors or billionaire backers the GOP can call up on speed dial.
That’s where we come in:
**Leaders We Deserve finds the most promising young candidates in the country, gives them the tools, training, and resources to win, and helps them start building the skills to govern effectively for decades to come.**
But we can’t do that without you.

| Peter,

As students and teachers prepare to head back to school, we’re reminded of the power of education and what it makes possible.

That same spirit drives our work at Emerge. We’re preparing Democratic women across the country to step up, speak out, and lead, whether that’s on a school board, in the statehouse, or in Congress.

Many of these women are teachers themselves.

Over 300 Emerge alums are current or former educators who’ve seen firsthand what’s at stake in our classrooms and communities, and who are stepping up to lead. One example is Congresswoman Becca Balint, a former middle school teacher from Vermont who became the first woman and first out LGBTQ+ person to represent her state in Congress.

These are the women who will fight for reproductive rights, defend our democracy, and challenge extremism at every level. But like every great education, our programs require resources.

[_**Can you chip in $10 or more today to help us continue training the women who are ready to lead?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/113329569/563408083/1143593133?refcode=BLU_EM_EMRG_2025-08-14_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkVNUi8xLzgxMzIxIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0Y2I4NWY2LTQyNzktZjAxMS1iNDgxLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-w1SE05kpFr6HTR8qU777y093abLiFXLMfzkPv8-Z48=)

Just like students returning to the classroom, Emerge women are showing up ready to learn, ready to lead, and ready to change the future.

Let’s give them everything they need to succeed.

subject: They’re coming for Social Security (again)

body:
The Trump Administration is trying the same old scheme George W. Bush tried in 2005.
#
90 years ago today, President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed the Social Security Act — a promise that after decades of hard work, Americans could retire with dignity and stability.
**Since then, Republicans have tried to break that promise._Several times.**_
From George W. Bush’s failed privatization push in the 2000s to Donald Trump’s dangerous plans today, they’ve looked for ways to gamble your hard-earned benefits. It’s wildly unpopular, but that’s never stopped them.
**If we don’t fight back, they might succeed.[Can you pitch in $5 to help support Sarah's work to protect Social Security from the GOP's latest scheme?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250814-1?refcode=em20250814-2267&amount=5&refcode2=2267_21716_WdHuMd&akid=2267%2E21716%2EWdHuMd)
Privatizing Social Security would slash guaranteed benefits, leave retirees vulnerable to market crashes, and unravel a critical safety net program that millions have relied on for years. It’s nothing more than a gift to Wall Street and a betrayal to working families.
In Congress, Sarah is working hard to strengthen Social Security and make sure it’s solvent for generations to come. **But she needs your support.**
Your contributions ensure Sarah has the resources she needs to continue fighting in Congress and pushing for the policies we need to uplift our neighbors across Delaware and the country.

Friend, The U.S. military has arrived in our nation’s capital, with National Guard troops on the ground along with a surge in federal law enforcement. We cannot be silent as Trump tries to silence dissent and militarize Black neighborhoods. The racist-in-chief named potential cities he may target next, including Chicago, Baltimore, Oakland, and other cities with Black mayors and majority Black and brown populations. He’s encouraging violent repression, telling law enforcement to “do whatever they want” and “knock the hell out of” people. Trump’s anti-Black and authoritarian takeover is a test run to target other major cities. His administration is planning to set up a rapid response group of National Guard troops for this very purpose. **Trump didn’t want to send in the National Guard on January 6th as a white supremacist mob attacked the Capitol but has no problem sending them into D.C. neighborhoods with majority Black residents.** Now is the time to speak up, before this fascism spreads further. [**Sign the petition to demand your members of Congress stand up to Trump’s fascism and end this militarized takeover.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39Vp4gkIh90ovDrixVFaBLcXvxRk_n6xNMWwz5Jdr9ju48Ss7ROG79yPlfzU6hcDhg7p6mRYeMR4l-naZHarzCV-3BJIQlvnJeSA8vuwvrHzMRs-W2qzTlblRYjRNUM2bre1rnwNrTNj8NqnTdJOvs0GK0NLdL06Yj6CNCNkmFhHefwhY9Yn4XMTrCiLrd3MjkwF_m9iKGTIP8hpU8qp-cNGsgCd1F7in1x4j8u8OiwZHmW7uWlixS0V_rke01Nze39HIDlZ5e4CIHX7uRCKhKUHyp8ZL1aBdc8oUZaLuYwFBOjOx7RJ3mLGvvfIeelApyKS_v6svfiN8JJ8haOBt9QW03dJmAf-GRac5LYi0ZzIg/4j1/q_sBTCw9Shi-lofd0AaQHQ/h1/h001.rh5cNpZ1ViGOsWMMIBZVIbl9dYz8wDjbqQnY8lO5Lac) | [SIGN NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39Vp4gkIh90ovDrixVFaBLcXvxRk_n6xNMWwz5Jdr9ju48Ss7ROG79yPlfzU6hcDhgTR7GIpF7SA6ny6-sRcbkKCZUEKXeSemCTEnb66tfMDzYaeIb97yDjtkLgtrEH4a1BgL4xriy5Ydz-lutJlqVo3SBLAGJcFxzt2YFB1EA4G7IsFJatQnp19449BapWLxSpgocVTUYFwHEyWBDIDl-XnTrsxtLQfwBHZGnojKAZ5yew6DrEsjqdmSHCaffFe8mRceES0lmSw2tJBUsiXtn_XvP9r3yjqjrXAg-n2orA6A8kk5rF_MY1QbL1ypJ2XKS-kRlumvR_UTdcMYHvqYci1vvWKO4qFPGb4PjXwMjeAw/4j1/q_sBTCw9Shi-lofd0AaQHQ/h2/h001.Y-3_e1z_pJ8ccT6AwwXtUj-qhaXjgSCWLpnOQ8xZpPM)
---
Trump is targeting Democrat-majority cities, likely punishing people for their votes and punishing Democratic politicians for opposing him. For example, Washington, D.C. is a majority Black city where over 90% of voters choose Democrats for president.
Trump is starting with D.C. because the city’s residents have less power—they don’t have statehood and they don’t even have full self-governance of their city.
In an abuse of his presidential power, Trump is exploiting a loophole in the _D.C. Home Rule Act of 1973_ that enables presidents to temporarily take over D.C.’s city government if there’s an emergency. But Trump’s “emergency” claims are racist lies: In D.C. and the other cities he’s named, crime rates are at historic lows.
D.C. residents weren’t able to vote for president until the 1960s, and they still lack voting representation in Congress. They even have limited control over their own city government: Congress can rewrite or block D.C. city budgets, and Congress reviews and regularly blocks city policies that have been voted for by a majority of D.C. residents.
This is the un-democratic status quo, which began and has persisted due to anti-Blackness.
Many enslaved people fled to D.C. after the Civil War and started to elect Black political leaders. White people pushed back against growing Black political power, using racist tropes to claim that Black people couldn’t govern themselves. Congress and the president began controlling the city, appointing leaders and overriding local democracy.
It’s past time for D.C. residents to finally have full enfranchisement and voting rights. With 700,000 residents, D.C. is more populous than Vermont and Wyoming. Both of those states have two senators and a voting member of the House of Representatives. The people of D.C. have voted overwhelmingly in support of statehood, but Congress hasn’t yet passed a policy to make it happen.
**Right now, local activists are asking people across the country to push their members of Congress to do three key things:** end Trump’s emergency declaration and get troops off D.C. streets, stop freezing D.C.’s city funds and trying to overturn local laws, and finally pass legislation making D.C. a state.
[**Please sign on and urge your members of Congress to act now. You can give D.C. residents a voice, since they have no voting member of Congress.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39Vp4gkIh90ovDrixVFaBLcXvxRk_n6xNMWwz5Jdr9ju48Ss7ROG79yPlfzU6hcDhiFnHmzIwxPyXEPbLFX2Cehmsfk1RG5HaQQBVf4QZxCbf3AZabkciYXU-e8QmKcoawJShdqkcpfyOaWkqQMNx6IMpal24O1ZydFts6ZTzirj4sHxgV2zI_IACxr2este_uWR7ndopCBqUWguTJPnYsu_cDU2LfcA4j7ALbDIyz15PaXzc1vAyhWeseTnqYz_eo3Rxtg1CsBgHCcjPY74_KKfH8Tq7U-DvmDnCzpxh6vBrZjPVnAFovoqJFMdGzDf5CucD3aOo53I4Syzao1dpSO9fN4QIboBFYbFy7nDWFo_A/4j1/q_sBTCw9Shi-lofd0AaQHQ/h3/h001.ZFEQ0UnO2k8I5J2m277lmRXXVdt46qwA_x3Mky8GuI0)

Last time Trump was in office, he called in the National Guard to D.C. during protests following George Floyd’s murder. Federal agents used rubber bullets, smoke bombs, flash grenades, and chemicals on peaceful protesters.
As part of the current attack on the city, Trump is deploying National Guard troops to forcibly displace unhoused people and lock them up. Because of the still-growing racial wealth gap, 85% of unhoused DC residents are Black—so this will have clear racial impacts.
This is happening during Black August, a month that honors Black political prisoners and other activists who’ve pushed for Black liberation. Pushing back against racist policing and making D.C. a state is part of the fight for Black liberation, power, and self-representation.
I’m a proud co-sponsor of the _Washington, D.C. Admission Act_ to grant D.C. statehood. I’ve also pushed for policies to keep our communities safe from police violence, reduce mass incarceration, empower and support unhoused people, keep people in their homes, and make housing more affordable.
**Our government should fund housing and care, not criminalization and prisons. I will keep pushing for this in Congress and I will keep fighting back against Trump’s fascism.**
Since D.C. residents don’t have a voting Congressperson, they’re asking you and others around the country to advocate on their behalf, urging your senators and representative to act now.
[**Add your name to demand an end to this fascist takeover and demand equal citizenship for D.C. residents.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39Vp4gkIh90ovDrixVFaBLcXvxRk_n6xNMWwz5Jdr9ju48Ss7ROG79yPlfzU6hcDhiN_zqWclP1OYiTzxMJmZ0WZOVqRZSKvOecruGcc1p-0mFoDg6EdC1nJQ6fxxqy2L7xcCOPLGR6AQ_URXb565J13YOVDUU52ZikLHbwsKa4BPtgrppziXe3NVlav_jIbN5FvvWg_xvegB07kEspHtGsuehlsj-0iz-akHXtjHLrl6NyAe0F8uuKdCWG_wQregAFlDl77EXfKjt_EjCTajzKbHN4lPcFTl-A3EmWbbP9xDAfyPQ--DIRFQ1RDAV1g3MLXHRp2zyklYUg9q8IGqG64bOy9VNJEky2HRq5DVD76A/4j1/q_sBTCw9Shi-lofd0AaQHQ/h5/h001.khiRscQzD4zAYUmrLux-AbVOSjbd2ypX9KPSOPDAqN0)
Thank you for taking action. Together, we’ll keep pushing for a democracy that lives up to the ideals of equal rights and representation for all. We must also keep defending the most vulnerable among us.
In solidarity,
Rashida

clean_body: Trump is deploying National Guard troops in our nation’s capital and temporarily taking control of the city’s police force. | | | Friend, The U.S. military has arrived in our nation’s capital, with National Guard troops on the ground along with a surge in federal law enforcement. We cannot be silent as Trump tries to silence dissent and militarize Black neighborhoods. The racist-in-chief named potential cities he may target next, including Chicago, Baltimore, Oakland, and other cities with Black mayors and majority Black and brown populations. He’s encouraging violent repression, telling law enforcement to “do whatever they want” and “knock the hell out of” people. Trump’s anti-Black and authoritarian takeover is a test run to target other major cities. His administration is planning to set up a rapid response group of National Guard troops for this very purpose. Trump didn’t want to send in the National Guard on January 6th as a white supremacist mob attacked the Capitol but has no problem sending them into D.C. neighborhoods with majority Black residents. Now is the time to speak up, before this fascism spreads further. | Trump is targeting Democrat-majority cities, likely punishing people for their votes and punishing Democratic politicians for opposing him. For example, Washington, D.C. is a majority Black city where over 90% of voters choose Democrats for president. Trump is starting with D.C. because the city’s residents have less power—they don’t have statehood and they don’t even have full self-governance of their city. In an abuse of his presidential power, Trump is exploiting a loophole in the D.C. Home Rule Act of 1973 that enables presidents to temporarily take over D.C.’s city government if there’s an emergency. But Trump’s “emergency” claims are racist lies: In D.C. and the other cities he’s named, crime rates are at historic lows. D.C. residents weren’t able to vote for president until the 1960s, and they still lack voting representation in Congress. They even have limited control over their own city government: Congress can rewrite or block D.C. city budgets, and Congress reviews and regularly blocks city policies that have been voted for by a majority of D.C. residents. This is the un-democratic status quo, which began and has persisted due to anti-Blackness. Many enslaved people fled to D.C. after the Civil War and started to elect Black political leaders. White people pushed back against growing Black political power, using racist tropes to claim that Black people couldn’t govern themselves. Congress and the president began controlling the city, appointing leaders and overriding local democracy. It’s past time for D.C. residents to finally have full enfranchisement and voting rights. With 700,000 residents, D.C. is more populous than Vermont and Wyoming. Both of those states have two senators and a voting member of the House of Representatives. The people of D.C. have voted overwhelmingly in support of statehood, but Congress hasn’t yet passed a policy to make it happen. Right now, local activists are asking people across the country to push their members of Congress to do three key things: end Trump’s emergency declaration and get troops off D.C. streets, stop freezing D.C.’s city funds and trying to overturn local laws, and finally pass legislation making D.C. a state. Last time Trump was in office, he called in the National Guard to D.C. during protests following George Floyd’s murder. Federal agents used rubber bullets, smoke bombs, flash grenades, and chemicals on peaceful protesters. As part of the current attack on the city, Trump is deploying National Guard troops to forcibly displace unhoused people and lock them up. Because of the still-growing racial wealth gap, 85% of unhoused DC residents are Black—so this will have clear racial impacts. This is happening during Black August, a month that honors Black political prisoners and other activists who’ve pushed for Black liberation. Pushing back against racist policing and making D.C. a state is part of the fight for Black liberation, power, and self-representation. I’m a proud co-sponsor of the Washington, D.C. Admission Act to grant D.C. statehood. I’ve also pushed for policies to keep our communities safe from police violence, reduce mass incarceration, empower and support unhoused people, keep people in their homes, and make housing more affordable. Our government should fund housing and care, not criminalization and prisons. I will keep pushing for this in Congress and I will keep fighting back against Trump’s fascism. Since D.C. residents don’t have a voting Congressperson, they’re asking you and others around the country to advocate on their behalf, urging your senators and representative to act now. Thank you for taking action. Together, we’ll keep pushing for a democracy that lives up to the ideals of equal rights and representation for all. We must also keep defending the most vulnerable among us. In solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . name: Chris Pappas
subject: The GOP is coming for marriage equality
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
This isn’t hypothetical. It’s real – and it’s personal.
Peter,
A decade ago when the Supreme Court finally recognized marriage equality as the law of the land, it affirmed the dignity of countless LGBTQ+ families across America.
_Now that very ruling is under threat._
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93687?refcode=em20250814-9271&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9271%2E614464%2EIz2hYj)
If the Court overturns marriage equality, loving couples could lose protections overnight. Families would be torn apart. Lives uprooted.
This isn’t hypothetical. It’s real — and it’s personal to me, my husband Vann, and so many Granite Staters.
**Elections have consequences.** The Senators we elect have a say in who sits on the Court, and those justices will shape our freedoms for generations to come.
Trump has stacked the Court with hardline conservatives — and right now extremists are determined to erase hard-won rights for LGBTQ+ families.
I can’t promise this fight will be easy or that the road ahead won’t be hard.
But I can promise you this: **I will never stop working to protect the rights and freedoms of every Granite Stater.**
**[Split $10 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots to win this Senate race and keep fighting for our rights.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/93687?refcode=em20250814-9271&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9271%2E614464%2EIz2hYj)**
With pride and determination,
Chris Pappas

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1g2p10bodnpchvl8zvmnfhokf7cxku1l04rgrzrw8b3viqjpzfoltqb3xry9mh5nl0m4odlfeywxmfofc2fqh10yut3z1b2w2jftrg61sdzihmofhg4msuyvoxyfbwfgt2gibf9bbm&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t10105&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t10105&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t10105&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t10105&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1g2p10bodnpchvl8zvmnfhokf7cxku1l04rgrzrw8b3viqjpzfoltqb3xry9mh5nl0m4odlfeywxmfofc2fqh10yut3z1b2w2jftrg61sdzihmofhg4msuyvoxyfbwfgt2gibf9bbm&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t10105&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t10105&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Dear Peter,**Today marks 90 years since Social Security was signed into law** — one of the boldest legislative achievements in our country’s history. Social Security provides a promise that after a lifetime of work, Americans can retire with dignity, stability, and support**Thanks to Donald Trump, that promise is under attack.** MAGA Republicans are pushing cuts and privatization schemes that would turn Social Security into a privilege for the wealthy — stealing from working people, including those who helped build and run this country. **By gutting every program that keeps vulnerable Americans afloat, our taxes are being stolen to fund state sponsored terror and other criminal ventures.** Trump and his MAGA vultures are literally committing hate crimes in our streets while defunding support to children, seniors, veterans, and the vulnerable. Trump and the Republicans have stolen $75 billion from us for ICE alone. **When our tax dollars no longer fund the basic guarantees of a functional and compassionate society, that’s taxation without representation.**[**If you believe Social Security and other pillars of our social safety net should be protected, I’m asking you to chip in $15, $25, or whatever you can to help us win this fight.**](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=e412f18c5c&e=5a6ee82cdb) Let’s honor the 90th anniversary of Social Security by making sure it’s still here — stronger than ever — for the 100th**In solidarity,****

Trump-backed law will force 2.4 million people off food stamps. Help us elect Democrats who will protect SNAP.
Republican leaders have once again ramped up their attacks on SNAP — slashing food assistance for families who need it most. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113332184/563417145/246949951?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2025.08.14_SNAP_B1_F1_S1_C1_45AC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MWU2OWMwZi00Yjc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5n0awny5ERqqrUhq0XXuVb0ndVp0TZqwmAOBoWVoskM=) Thanks to Trump’s Big, Beautiful Betrayal, new work requirements now threaten to cut SNAP benefits for an estimated 2.4 million people, including families with children and veterans. Senator Kirsten Gillibrand has been fighting to protect SNAP and food security for years. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113332673/563418858/-788614911?refcode=AU_SMP_FR_GEN_MQG_AC30_20250814_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODY3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZWY3MmJlZi00Yzc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Fx8U54FDH_Tii6T-0aPGFFmo8sH9Flshf0RDBxLXqpk=) Team, I’ll cut to the chase: America is in **deep, deep trouble.** In just the first six months of Trump’s second term, here’s what we’ve seen:
* Massive tax cuts for billionaires while kicking millions of Americans off of their health insurance.
* Federal officers fired for being “disloyal.”
* Civil servants purged.
* Critics arrested.
* Trump’s DOJ used to retaliate against political enemies.
* The economy tanked with reckless tariffs and chaos.
* **And worst of all: no one’s stopping him.**

The Supreme Court ruled he has absolute immunity. The Republican Congress cheers him on. And Democrats in the Senate? Despite fighting like hell, we’re outnumbered, losing vote after vote while Trump rewrites laws by executive order. Social Security? On the chopping block. The Department of Education? Dismantled. Fellow Conservative,

**Did you know that Americans spend between 8 and 12 seconds reading an email before they decide to keep going or click away?**

I hope you’ll indulge me today and spend a bit more time than that reading this _**critical email**_ right now.

I still remember the morning of September 11th, 2001. I was an 18-year-old in Bloomington, Minnesota, watching smoke rise from the Twin Towers. In that moment, I knew my life would never be the same. That same day, **I decided: I would fight for my country.**

_[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=349c15c067e948878385069124a28896&_e=UbILYiz0Km9gnUf8RT_2VyVmGcEwY-bps217KAGrAQ3ruo4oPbAf2xVLr3zw9rGUhr49rT2ExkXDZm77-W8jbyOghj5bbb6X-V1h7mUP4BHjVxUGm9yv5t6yiONeTw7ykS9g0YOEC_XXQCnSQJgGkxBQ4liIUvY19XQhIPbq8Ii_X88FKLox_T2OA1_pq4VdU0XKvibmwTdIyyFejKNyDLwHHurrGEnTHmUC77-QG32EVmkWFGtKHVAemwIS9ZeoRbGRQmhFamaMDAcHWmg7QuEtHXDvFgPECVNH0mME_uOjBzZO4_7s2eduIyuLr1KI2AfWbxKeyp68yKjDIZlsEoi6na8f7V4jd-SkIiyv7Q9uueD-iEfW50-grHNqBaZwuulOr1A_dJ1OjhQBOM58FCWJSBdVULQjQmQBfdmGAc5D6rstCDZ-S7kcbw-Ko-VhvRDw8qNPlUKfMWGHRK2Permx_VVUISy6U5HU8SD6hfz2u5nysHy5S3Pk0mK6o-vpCPtiLl7Rw4LzCYida4t6KVKsPhwIdm_YLNcl88lKEO9glBDLVcI2Nzn7pkB3VEqpTloALj0_j4CmhDnKM8yNxdShfuOKWuE7XmRwLb1u_S5pSL_Fu_XozAYM70TswIHVrUxt48aYXtJFxEUTdPDZ9QVGUEBGZzY9fCv0-KCPF6qdaKjURpQuZXCCrScNA0evD9xI2bPWcPodAuOYMuLdxY-_tZBSroRiuWUHpV-YQ2A%3D)_
My name is Adam Schwarze, a 20-year veteran of the Marine infantry and Navy SEALs.

Shortly after my 18th birthday, I raised my right hand and swore an oath to defend the United States of America. That oath took me from the frozen streets of Minnesota to the sands of Iraq, the mountains of Afghanistan, and into the shadows where danger lived.

[**SEND A SEAL TO THE SENATE →**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=349c15c067e948878385069124a28896&_e=UbILYiz0Km9gnUf8RT_2VyVmGcEwY-bps217KAGrAQ3ruo4oPbAf2xVLr3zw9rGUqTZe8PZ8jedrTRfbMDqEkfyy5JkZTOmKcDC_xDjZgL7uORddEOwvXecODfz1QH0_oAVN5grtFhTxNwy99ixrKwoPIvbzuyUXdgAEjOVRMX4HFXSWm4qrAPHDuHsD6rpkDgaW5KHngpM6qA4EY3rKS5GMRVg-Nyrz4ITBpPc0Xv1HlW5mYqjFPgLAx3wmVgEzv8G6ZUHUB7Ql4EHkWzDaNGICoOWfRxVuHPD3nsScZY2riT_qp_YerPXBotEdN-zEpcUYu1plvLcyNmKrUHB5-6fFurWN9DXCg_tnf2hXj3W7ySHuGq0EqfNpD_o_pea-_ga368jW_hvyRS5usBXW_XDxlpBTsz4lXY_dHSgPtur_w7qh0vt7Np1lDz3xoHIrWFPu6YXi6fT7jXtZrlrxzvAES_KRtYt_V0OiCW42mGTwhWW_DOqcVE1W8kolNQt5otcgw-6EvjJ2MQgUpR0I3J8MFoUhhJwWU_ADeV-qGqdy-l2YRbWZfS5vsgIgz7G2tdukIF9b8Roz2X6h-LqRluMBP3FkHbpVWeNAHttVZcRHAD87DIyWIZ0D2Tahpj_z9niLKM5HHYB096KdSSwzfNKbpas2i8aFttmpX4-iQX8OYMcg9Sd0Kdvn9WwoVl2Fmylb6qUiYqnuLp7ezykIZg%3D%3D)
For 20 years — nine deployments to more than 70 countries — I carried our flag into places where failure was not an option. I fought beside the bravest men and women I’ll ever know. I’ve seen the cost of freedom up close. And I will never forget why we fight.

But today, I look at our country and see a different kind of battlefield.

While working families struggle to put food on the table, Washington insiders get richer. While our border is overrun, politicians turn their backs.

While our children fall behind, radicals push an agenda that erodes the values we grew up with.

This isn’t the America I risked my life for. And I’ll be damned if I stand by and watch her fade away.

**I’m running for the United States Senate, but not because I want a title. Not because I planned a political career. But the fight for America didn’t end for me when I hung up my uniform.**

I don’t know how to quit; I never give up. And I’m not afraid of a fight. Just ask our enemies.

We can rebuild this country — stronger, freer, and prouder than ever.

The Senate seat I’m seeking hasn’t been winnable since 2009, but now, suddenly, it’s a top-tier target for Republicans, and I plan to be the man who brings home the win for our party. _**My only problem is that I don’t have enough cash to get my campaign off the ground, and I can’t self-fund.**_

clean_body: The oath I took to protect and serve Old Glory has taken me from the frozen streets of Minnesota to the sands of Iraq, the depths of our oceans and into the shadows where danger lived. | Fellow Conservative, Did you know that Americans spend between 8 and 12 seconds reading an email before they decide to keep going or click away? I hope you’ll indulge me today and spend a bit more time than that reading this critical email right now. I still remember the morning of September 11th, 2001. I was an 18-year-old in Bloomington, Minnesota, watching smoke rise from the Twin Towers. In that moment, I knew my life would never be the same. That same day, I decided: I would fight for my country. My name is Adam Schwarze, a 20-year veteran of the Marine infantry and Navy SEALs. Shortly after my 18th birthday, I raised my right hand and swore an oath to defend the United States of America. That oath took me from the frozen streets of Minnesota to the sands of Iraq, the mountains of Afghanistan, and into the shadows where danger lived. For 20 years — nine deployments to more than 70 countries — I carried our flag into places where failure was not an option. I fought beside the bravest men and women I’ll ever know. I’ve seen the cost of freedom up close. And I will never forget why we fight. But today, I look at our country and see a different kind of battlefield. While working families struggle to put food on the table, Washington insiders get richer. While our border is overrun, politicians turn their backs. While our children fall behind, radicals push an agenda that erodes the values we grew up with. This isn’t the America I risked my life for. And I’ll be damned if I stand by and watch her fade away. I’m running for the United States Senate, but not because I want a title. Not because I planned a political career. But the fight for America didn’t end for me when I hung up my uniform. I don’t know how to quit; I never give up. And I’m not afraid of a fight. Just ask our enemies. We can rebuild this country — stronger, freer, and prouder than ever. The Senate seat I’m seeking hasn’t been winnable since 2009, but now, suddenly, it’s a top-tier target for Republicans, and I plan to be the man who brings home the win for our party. My only problem is that I don’t have enough cash to get my campaign off the ground, and I can’t self-fund. I don’t know where I was on November 3rd, 2008, but when I write out that date, the last full day we had a Republican representing Minnesota in the U.S. Senate before an election, it feels like a lifetime ago. We will secure our border so we can welcome those who love America — and send criminals packing. We will rebuild our economy so working people can live with dignity and opportunity. We will put parents back in charge of their children’s education. We will defend the Constitution — every single word of it. But I can’t do it alone. I’ve carried our flag into battle. And I will never stop fighting for it. clean_body: Here’s how New Dems are fighting to ensure it turns 100 >> | Today officially rings in 90 years since Social Security was enacted. And in all that time – despite war, pandemics, and presidential shifts in power – Social Security has never missed a single payment. It has provided critical funds for children, seniors, and vulnerable populations to be able to pay for food, medicine, and it has provided Americans a chance to retire with dignity. Now, under Trump’s leadership this lifeline for millions of Americans is under threat. | In an effort to accelerate policies that will give millions in tax giveaways to billionaires, his administration has made cuts including the largest cut to Medicaid in modern history this past June. And Social Security is on the chopping block next. But not if we work together to prevent MAGA Republicans from ending it through loopholes like backdoor privatization. New Dems are fighting in Congress to stop Republicans from letting Social Security turn 100 and stop the realization of the American dream that everyone has a fair shot at achieving economic opportunity. federalized California National Guard troops and Marines for civilian law

Trump did and why it was illegal.

domestic law enforcement — and from maintaining a standing army in
Southern California.

posted every step of the way — but right now, I just want to take a second
to thank you for all your support.

None of this would be possible without this team’s commitment to justice
and freedom for all — I wouldn’t be Attorney General without you by my

support.

When President Trump took office in 2017, Scott Brown was our second diplomat

President Trump’s“Peace through Strength” offensive.

years pushing back against China’s aggression in the region, and I saw Scott
Brown fight EVERY. SINGLE. DAY. against China and for American exceptionalism.

President Trump and I trusted Scott to carry out the foreign policy of the
administration. He represented America with resolve every single day until his
last day of service under President Trump’s leadership.

clean_body: | | - | - I'm Retired Brigadier General Shawn Harris -- and I'm running against the most dangerous voice in Congress, Marjorie Taylor Greene. When I was a kid in rural Georgia, summers meant gathering under the big elm tree at my neighbor's house. That's where the county delivered free lunches -- peanut butter sandwiches, fruit, milk -- so no kid went hungry. We laughed, we played, and we looked out for each other. Now Marjorie Taylor Greene wants to gut SNAP and slash the local programs that made moments like that possible. She's forgotten what it means to look out for your neighbors. I never will. I served this nation for 40 years. I'm running for Congress to protect the lifelines that help our kids, our families, and our communities thrive. Peter, Nobody wins a redistricting arms race, least of all the American people. But Trump’s demand for extreme and unjustified mid-decade gerrymanders in Texas and beyond — with too many Republicans ready and willing to be complicit in his orders to predetermine the outcome of the next federal election — has brought a new, dangerous threat to free and fair elections in America. That’s why I support responsible and responsive actions — on a temporary basis — to ensure that the foundations of our democracy are not permanently eroded and to leave a basis for needed reform. Governor Newsom’s proposal for a redraw process adheres to that vision. It stands in stark contrast to the power grab unfolding in Texas, by allowing voters a chance to weigh in and, in 2030, returning California to its long-standing commission process. **Our democracy is under attack. We have no choice but to defend it. ** Unlike in the immediate past, when we again have the power to enact bold policies that reimagine and rebuild a democracy that is actually responsive to the people, we must do so. This has to include the passage of an enhanced Voting Rights Act and a federal ban against partisan gerrymandering, to ensure that our nation never has to go through this again. Eric H. Holder, Jr.

### **Alaska District 27: Anatomy of a Takedown**
---
### **The Decisive Factor: Party vs. Incumbent**
**David Eastman's landslide primary victory should have guaranteed his re-election. However, the Alaska GOP establishment intervened, prioritizing control over conservative principles and orchestrating an unprecedented takedown of their own incumbent.**
#### **Unprecedented Financial Intervention**
The Alaska GOP took the highly unusual step of giving $3,000 directly to Jubilee Underwood's campaign to be used against their own incumbent, David Eastman. This financial backing signaled a clear party-led effort to unseat him.
#### **Ideology Betrayed**
Eastman, holding a perfect 100% conservative rating, was cast aside. The party establishment labeled him "toxic" and a block to "party unity," effectively punishing the most ideologically-aligned conservative in the state legislature.
#### **Establishment Control Over Principles**
The party's actions reveal a prioritization of maintaining establishment control over supporting conservative principles. By backing a more compliant challenger, they ensured the removal of a dissenting voice, regardless of his conservative credentials.
#### **Ranked-Choice Voting as a Tool**
Ranked-Choice Voting (RCV) created the environment for this outcome. It allowed the establishment to back a single challenger without fear of splitting the vote, effectively weaponizing the system to sideline a principled dissenter and ensure a preferred outcome.

### The Fight for Fair Elections: A Personal Mission
When I began the effort to repeal Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) in Alaska, I knew it would be a challenge. But I was determined not to let our electoral process be twisted into a confusing system that leaves voters disempowered.My commitment went beyond Alaska. I wrote **three books** and created a **30-part animated video series** to expose the truth about RCV, distributing thousands of copies and making the videos free nationwide. I've also spent countless hours collaborating with grassroots leaders across the country, helping establish organizations now fighting RCV. My websites, **RCValert.org** and **RemoveRCV.com** , offer years of research, resources, and tools like RCV Election Simulators.This fight is personal. My own grandfather, a wise and hardworking man, couldn't understand the ranked choice ballot. If someone with his common sense was confused, I knew there was a fundamental flaw. That moment spurred me to draft Alaska's repeal initiative.We didn't have billionaire funding or political party backing. What we had was unwavering determination and the support of over **700 dedicated Alaskan volunteers**. We knocked on doors, braved the cold, and gathered over **42,000 signatures** —far exceeding the requirement—all without help from political insiders.I've also traveled nationwide, warning states like Idaho, Oregon, Arizona, and Florida about RCV's manipulative nature, funded by out-of-state billionaires.As expected, the political establishment fought us. The attorney who brought RCV to Alaska even sued to prevent our repeal initiative from appearing on the ballot. But we prevailed in both the Alaska Superior Court and the Alaska Supreme Court. They outspent us by a staggering **one hundred to one** , with millions flowing in from out-of-state organizations like Unite America and the Sixteen Thirty Fund, supported by figures like George Soros and Hansjorg Wyss.On Election Day, I was immensely proud. Not only had I fought RCV in Alaska for years, but seven other states where I'd been active decisively rejected it. Those rejections alone cost the pro-RCV lobby nearly **$150 million** between 2020 and 2024. Here in Alaska, despite our small population, it took nearly three weeks to get election results—a clear example of RCV's confusion and delay.Our repeal effort in Alaska came agonizingly close, falling short by just 743 votes after nearly three weeks of counting. But my resolve is unbroken. This fight is a warning to the entire country. We must maintain simple, clear, and honest elections, demanding voter ID and keeping out-of-state special interests out.I am incredibly proud of what we achieved in Alaska. We showed the nation what ordinary, hardworking people can accomplish when they stand firm. The fight isn't over—not in Alaska, and not anywhere freedom-loving Americans call home.**Stand with us! Let's protect our elections for Alaska and for America.**

Big thank you to all the supporters and followers, volunteers, and donors. The Fight for Fair Elections: A Personal Mission When I began the effort to repeal Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) in Alaska, I knew it would be a challenge. But I was determined not to let our electoral process be twisted into a confusing system that leaves voters disempowered.My commitment went beyond Alaska. I wrote three books and created a 30-part animated video series to expose the truth about RCV, distributing thousands of copies and making the videos free nationwide. I've also spent countless hours collaborating with grassroots leaders across the country, helping establish organizations now fighting RCV. My websites, RCValert.org and RemoveRCV.com , offer years of research, resources, and tools like RCV Election Simulators.This fight is personal. My own grandfather, a wise and hardworking man, couldn't understand the ranked choice ballot. If someone with his common sense was confused, I knew there was a fundamental flaw. That moment spurred me to draft Alaska's repeal initiative.We didn't have billionaire funding or political party backing. What we had was unwavering determination and the support of over 700 dedicated Alaskan volunteers. We knocked on doors, braved the cold, and gathered over 42,000 signatures —far exceeding the requirement—all without help from political insiders.I've also traveled nationwide, warning states like Idaho, Oregon, Arizona, and Florida about RCV's manipulative nature, funded by out-of-state billionaires.As expected, the political establishment fought us. Those rejections alone cost the pro-RCV lobby nearly $150 million between 2020 and 2024. Here in Alaska, despite our small population, it took nearly three weeks to get election results—a clear example of RCV's confusion and delay.Our repeal effort in Alaska came agonizingly close, falling short by just 743 votes after nearly three weeks of counting. But my resolve is unbroken. This fight is a warning to the entire country. We must maintain simple, clear, and honest elections, demanding voter ID and keeping out-of-state special interests out.I am incredibly proud of what we achieved in Alaska. We showed the nation what ordinary, hardworking people can accomplish when they stand firm. The fight isn't over—not in Alaska, and not anywhere freedom-loving Americans call home.Stand with us! In a statement, members of the minority party said their lawyers had advised them to return “to build a strong public legislative record for the upcoming legal battle” against the proposed reconfiguration of Texas’ congressional districts. The new map, stalled since dozens of Democrats Aug. 3, is designed to net the GOP five additional seats in the U.S. House. President Donald Trump pressured state leaders to undertake the effort mid-decade — a rarity — as the GOP tries to hold onto its thin majority in Congress. » Gov. Greg Abbott , who has to remove House Democratic Caucus leader Gene Wu from office, said earlier this week he would continue calling special legislative sessions — after both chambers of the Legislature adjourn. House Speaker Dustin Burrows said he would gavel out for the session if the lower chamber continued to lack a quorum, or the minimum number of present members required to conduct business. The House, which needs 100 of its 150 members present to establish a quorum, has not reached that threshold since most of the chamber’s 62 Democrats left the state for Chicago, Massachusetts and New York in an effort to stop the proposed redistricting. Democratic lawmakers say the new map is an attack on the representation of minority voters in the districts being redrawn, while Republicans have defended their right to redraw district lines for partisan gain whenever they want. » “Texas House Democrats broke quorum and successfully mobilized the nation against Trump's assault on minority voting rights," Wu, D-Houston, said in a statement. “Facing threats of arrest, lawfare, financial penalties, harassment, and bomb threats, we have stood firm in our fight against a proposed Jim Crow congressional district map.” California Gov. Gavin Newsom on Thursday called a special election for a ballot measure to ask voters to approve a new congressional map to counter Texas’ effort. Earlier this week, that California Democratic leaders said they had sufficient votes to pass the amendment. “Trump’s election rigging comes to an end now,” Newsom said in a social media post. “California won’t stand by and watch Trump burn it all down — we are calling a special election to redraw our Congressional maps and defend fair representation. This is a five alarm fire for Democracy.”" “Illinois judge denies Ken Paxton 's bid for help rounding up Democrats,” Houston Chronicle'sTaylor Goldenstein \-- "An Illinois judge on Wednesday ruled against Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in his who fled there to block a vote on redistricting. In a brief ruling, Adams County Circuit Judge Scott Larson found that he "does not have the inherent power" to decide whether the 13 Democrats that Paxton had claimed were violating civil warrants issued by the Texas House, let alone to help Texas enforce them. Larson found that Paxton “failed to present a legal basis for the court to obtain subject matter jurisdiction over this action.” Neither Paxton nor the House Democratic Caucus immediately responded to a request for comment. The third-term Republican attorney general filed a similar suit in California that is still pending." # Report: D.C. Mayor escapes to Martha's Vineyard amid Trump city takeover
DC Mayor Muriel Bowser **[traveled to Martha's Vineyard](https://substack.com/redirect/eb17b0e4-751f-46d6-8fb4-a24e61ec542e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Thursday for a "family commitment," according to Fox News, just days after President Trump federalized the city's police department on Monday following high-profile crimes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1a255ed5-83b0-4c47-84b3-751a5f52da13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump assumed emergency control of DC's Metropolitan Police Department** under the Home Rule Act, deploying hundreds of National Guard troops and federal agencies including FBI, DEA, and ATF for a comprehensive law enforcement crackdown.
* **Despite claims that overall crime has decreased, DC has the highest violent crime lethality rate** among 17 major US cities, with a 38% increase in lethality in 2024 compared to 2018 and a 341% jump since 2012, according to a Council on Criminal Justice study.
* **Bowser criticized Trump's federalization as "an intrusion on our autonomy"** during a Tuesday town hall, calling it an "authoritarian push" and urging the community to "protect our home rule" while hoping for a Democratic House to serve as a "backstop."

body:

#
Hey team, it's Governor Andy Beshear. When I first ran for Attorney General in Kentucky, people said it couldn’t be done. When I ran for Governor, everyone told me the state had become too red and a Democrat couldn’t break through the partisan noise. But three races – and three wins – later, our campaign proved everyone wrong. I didn’t win three times as a Democrat in deep-red Kentucky by bowing down to party politics. I won by sticking to my values, staying true to my faith, and never forgetting who I would serve when I entered office. I listened to what Kentuckians had to say, stood up for their rights and addressed their concerns, just like our leaders are supposed to. When I launched In This Together PAC, I did it with a simple goal: **To support good people in hard races—not just in Kentucky, but nationwide.** I want to share the approach that has helped us win tough elections, and support the campaigns of leaders who show up, tell the truth, and actually do the job the American people hired them to do. [**That's why I’m proud to support Kristen McDonald Rivet, and why I'm asking you to split a contribution of $3 between In This Together PAC and Kristen McDonald Rivet's campaign today. >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113336278/563431426/1824071738?refcode=em-8.14.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDAxNjIwNi01YTc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P_WoeFh9t3R1rcwzu9h-J9uCqoksoMUcaCau40iOR7s=) Kristen is the kind of person ITT PAC was built to support. She is on the DCCC’s Frontline list, meaning her district is really competitive and the Republicans are gearing up to try to defeat her next November. Throughout her career, she has stood up for the people of Michigan's 8th district at every turn. From fighting to expand access to healthcare to creating good paying jobs to protecting the rights of everyone, Kristen has proven she has what it takes to be a leader for all. And today, her leadership is needed more than ever. Partisan politics are wreaking havoc on our democracy. Congress is writing and passing laws tailor-made to support the wealthy, while leaving everyday folks behind. That’s not what real leadership is about—and we can’t afford to let it continue. At In This Together PAC, we’re backing leaders who show up, do the work, and never forget who they were elected to serve. Kristen has proven time and again that hard work, fairness, and common sense can still win, no matter which political party you belong to. Now, it’s up to us to ensure she has the resources to compete from now to Election Day. I listened to what Kentuckians had to say, stood up for their rights and addressed their concerns, just like our leaders are supposed to. When I launched In This Together PAC, I did it with a simple goal: To support good people in hard races—not just in Kentucky, but nationwide. I want to share the approach that has helped us win tough elections, and support the campaigns of leaders who show up, tell the truth, and actually do the job the American people hired them to do. = Kristen is the kind of person ITT PAC was built to support. She is on the DCCC’s Frontline list, meaning her district is really competitive and the Republicans are gearing up to try to defeat her next November. Throughout her career, she has stood up for the people of Michigan's 8th district at every turn. From fighting to expand access to healthcare to creating good paying jobs to protecting the rights of everyone, Kristen has proven she has what it takes to be a leader for all. And today, her leadership is needed more than ever. Partisan politics are wreaking havoc on our democracy. Congress is writing and passing laws tailor-made to support the wealthy, while leaving everyday folks behind. That’s not what real leadership is about—and we can’t afford to let it continue. At In This Together PAC, we’re backing leaders who show up, do the work, and never forget who they were elected to serve. Kristen has proven time and again that hard work, fairness, and common sense can still win, no matter which political party you belong to. Now, it’s up to us to ensure she has the resources to compete from now to Election Day. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = ** | = | | = | = | | = | =** Thank you, Gov. subject: Texas Democrats risked everything for our democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Andrea Salinas for Oregon
body:
Republicans have drawn new congressional maps designed to take five Democratic-held seats in Texas—not by earning more votes, but by manipulating the system to lock in GOP power ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

It’s Beto O’Rourke here. Republicans have drawn new congressional maps designed to take five Democratic-held seats in Texas—not by earning more votes, but by manipulating the system to lock in GOP power ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. #### **Clothing Drive Update**
---
|
## What Community Looks Like
---
| My campaign is built on a mission of**real service and real results,** making a difference in our community now, not just after an election. This past July, we did just that, running a month-long clothing drive where I personally drove all over Central Florida, picking up donations and meeting people where they are.

---
| **I'm so proud to report that our "Community First" clothing drive is officially complete. I am absolutely overwhelmed with gratitude!**

---
| Thanks to donors from all across Central Florida, every item collected is now on its way to help homeless veterans, single mothers and their children, and our neighbors in need.
Here are just a few of my favorite photos from the drop-off event!

---
|

---
|

---
|
---
| This is what a people-powered movement looks like. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being a part of it.

---
| If you're looking for more ways to get involved, please visit the events page. We are also starting weekly virtual volunteer meetings to plan our next "Community First" initiatives!
**In solidarity,**
**Marialana Kinter**

Peter,

When I talk with Rhode Islanders, one thing is crystal clear: **People are working harder than ever, and still struggling to keep up.**

Meanwhile, Trump and House Republicans pushed through their _Big Ugly Bill_ : another massive handout to billionaires and big corporations. They’ve rigged the system to benefit the ultra-wealthy while everyday Americans fall further behind.

Here’s what I’m fighting for instead:

✔ **A tax break for the middle class and those working to join it** , because working families deserve relief, not just the ultra-rich.
✔ **Enhanced Social Security benefits,** because our seniors have earned peace of mind, not cuts.
✔ **A right to unionize,** because no one should be punished for standing up for better pay and safer working conditions.
✔ ️ **Paid time off for all workers,** because no one should have to choose between a paycheck and their health or family.

_I’m in Washington to fight for working people,_ but we’re up against a well-funded MAGA machine that will stop at _nothing_ to hold onto power and pad the pockets of their wealthy donors.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Vladimir Putin is a war criminal
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
It is no show of strength to allow him to fly into the United States, to land here, and negotiate with our president — and especially not if the outcome is to negotiate away Ukraine’s sovereignty in a dangerous attempt at appeasement.
#

Folks, I’ve been to Ukraine multiple times since Putin started this illegal war in 2022.
I have seen the damage. I have met with Ukrainian fighters and their wounded at a military hospital. I’ve listened to everyday Ukrainians who witnessed horrible things.
Vladimir Putin is a war criminal who must be held accountable for the atrocities Russia has committed in Ukraine. It is no show of strength to allow him to fly into the United States, to land here, and negotiate with our president — and especially not if the outcome is to negotiate away Ukraine’s sovereignty in a dangerous attempt at appeasement.
If Trump invited him here with no concessions extracted — with nothing in return — it makes us look weak.
Frankly, it’s disgusting. It’s another needless abdication of America’s role as a champion for democracy on the world stage. It empowers people like Putin and puts our allies at a disadvantage. That makes us less safe.
Ukraine must win this war. Not just for their own sake but for ours, too. We can’t allow unchecked Russian aggression to threaten a broader conflict, because if that happens, it is American troops who will be called up to stop it.
I continue to stand firm with Ukraine and our European allies, and I’m not afraid to say so.
Far too much is at stake here to do any less.
Thank you,
Mark

That’s me! Way before I had the honor of serving Michiganders in Congress and launching this battleground campaign to be Michigan’s next U.S. senator. I was about 12 or 13 years old there. But don’t be fooled by school picture day _(and my trendy beaded necklace)_. Growing up as the daughter of small business owners – Mom and Dad had their own landscaping business – I was always around a lot of dirt, grease, grime, and heavy machinery.**I wouldn’t have had it any other way.** My parents taught me the value of hard work – a value that binds all of us in Michigan together. After all, we’re the state that built America. The state that built the middle class. In fact, do you know what one of my favorite memories is from growing up? When I got the keys to my first car, a used Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. That car represented the newfound freedom of teenage years. **But it was more to me than just that – it also meant I had a piece of Michigan.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/113337180/563434135/698416938?refcode=250813_MFC_Stevens_Story&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NzdlOThjZi01Yzc5LWYwMTEtYjQ4MS02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kYifa_uI4TheGIsoErKVff3pR8LdgOr_LN4EZBdV3K8=) I love Michigan. I love the people here. And I love that I’ve been able to fight for my state in Congress. But as I’ve traveled our state recently, it’s clear that the people I love are afraid. They’re afraid because of the chaos and uncertainty that Donald Trump and Elon Musk are inflicting upon our nation. All across our state, I hear concerns about rising costs, fear of uncertainty in our auto industry, and worries about the future of Social Security and Medicare. And you better believe people are outright disturbed by Trump’s attacks on our democracy and personal freedoms. This fear, uncertainty, and chaos – all of it is unacceptable. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. I’m ready to fight for the people I love and help block Trump’s dangerous agenda. # LET’S DO THIS FOR OUR FUTURE!🌵
Adelita for Congress Newsletter
---
| Hi Peter,
After this weekend, there are only **six weekends left** until the general election—six chances to make your voice heard for Southern Arizona. It’s time to double down. **Join us this Saturday, August 16th, for our Enviros for Adelita Canvass! 🌿✨**
With so much at stake at the federal level, our environment—and our future—hang in the balance. This is our only home. **Adelita** is ready to fight for our environment and our communities in Congress—but she can’t do it without us. That means showing up, knocking on doors, talking to voters, and making sure they head to the polls this September.
**Like recycling, small acts create big change.** Every door knocked, every conversation, every voter reminded—it all adds up.

Peter, On August 14, 1935, the _Social Security Act_ was signed into law — finalizing the United States’ promise to seniors that they would be able to live out their retirement years with dignity and security after a lifetime of work. **90 years later, Donald Trump and Republicans are doing whatever they can to gut Social Security just so they can give more money to their billionaire donors.** Trump’s top donor and the richest man in the world, Elon Musk, called Social Security a “Ponzi scheme” and spread lie after lie about this critical program. Let’s set the record straight. Social Security isn’t a windfall or a scheme — it is a fund that hard-working Americans **_paid into_** , relying on our government’s promise that it would be there to help when they retire. But these kinds of lies about Social Security underpin the Trump administration and the forces that got Trump back into the White House. [1]Justice Democrats

Republican Senator John Cornyn is coming after me on
Twitter, Peter.

Last week, my colleagues and I on the House Oversight Committee sent a
letter to Attorney General Pam Bondi and FBI Director Kash Patel. We’re
asking questions and calling out how, at Cornyn’s request, the FBI is
being used to intimidate and harass Texas lawmakers who broke quorum to
fight Abbott’s corrupt, racist redistricting scheme.

These lawmakers were doing what democracy demands — engaging in political
protest against injustice, and defending voting rights.

But Cornyn? He wants to criminalize that protest. He wants to weaponize
law enforcement against people fighting for democracy. And he's abusing
his power to do it.

He took to Twitter to say — directly to me — that it’s okay to use law
enforcement to go after Democrats for standing up — even though no federal
crimes were committed.

So Senator Cornyn, I have something to say directly to you, too:

John. We know each other. You were one of the only Republicans to reach
out to me when I joined Congress.

I mistakenly thought you were the kind of patriot who would not cower to
Trump and his abuses. You are causing long-term harm to American democracy
by encouraging federal law enforcement to arrest lawmakers over political
disagreements. Do not further disgrace yourself by doing what you know is
wrong — you are likely to lose to Ken Paxton either way. Please do not
further taint your legacy, and the end of your long career, this way.

- Congressman Greg Casar

Peter, lawmakers
like Cornyn don’t scare me or intimidate me. If anything, they make me
fight harder against the corruption they enable.

But I can’t do this alone. This fight against corruption and
authoritarianism needs all of us organizing, speaking out, and standing
together.

**According to the 2022 Census of Agriculture, there are more than 18,500 farms here in our district, and over 86,000 across the state.** Nearly 82% are family-owned. These families work tirelessly season after season to feed our nation and keep rural Iowa strong.

Margins shrink while uncertainty grows, and the pressure on family farms mounts.

Today's _Amped Up_ with Cliff Schecter brought the fire as Cliff, David Schuster, and Malcolm Nance tore into the looming "Orange Yalta"--Trump's upcoming sit-down with Vladimir Putin. They laid bare Trump's cognitive decline, delusional Nobel Prize fantasies, and dangerous willingness to sell out Ukraine for his own ego.
And other reasons. One example--and only one of many times the three broke out in laughter--is when Cliff asked Malcolm, "how do you say in Russian 'are you in the Epstein Files too?'"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/32019810-e71f-485a-8ff1-a9bba6b37fb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Be prepared: Malcolm brought his salty navy language, Cliff ported in a bit of profanity from his days growing up in NY and David...
David, a hilarious guy in a Emmy-winning news man's body, is begin to let loose now that he's on Substack/Youtube. He wondered aloud if Trump might plan to give Putin a "bl*wjob." Yahtzee! Whether literal or metaphorical, David didn't specify.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b2e34726-2f48-4bde-93e5-452df0d89068?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The conversation, overall, veered from dark comedy (Trump's obsession with toilet paper stuck to his shoe) to the deadly serious stakes of this idiot meeting. David questioned how Trump could even grant the war criminal a summit on U.S. soil.
Malcolm pointed out that for Putin it was about "regaining parity with the U.S." He also discussed how effectively Ukraine's frontlines have fought back, and how both Trump's lies and serious physical and mental health decline directly threaten policy.
Malcolm also revealed details about Epstein's strong ties to Russia, and all three laughed about Melania's lawsuit fiasco--she's suing Hunter Biden, which led them all to surmise Melania may just be enamored with naked pics of Biden. _The ones MTG paraded around during congressional hearings like her very own precious metal._
Malcolm also discussed his new _FAFO PAC_ project--which includes a nationwide "Great Highway Overpass Takeover" campaign aimed at blasting short, emotional, truth-bomb messages into public consciousness via signs on overpasses everywhere and constantly, to be seen by those driving by underneath on highways.
**In short: this episode mixed brutal honesty, gallows humor, and hard strategy -- exactly what you tune in to **_**Amped Up**_**for. Definitely a MUST WATCH episode!**
